title: Notes
text: Speak to Gatekeeper Gostoc at the castle's gatehouse.
Enter the castle using the secret, back entrance.
Find Sorcerer Rogier at the castle's chapel.
Meet Nepheli before reaching Godrick the Grafted.
Defeat Godrick the Grafted and claim his Great Rune.
Explore the Castle's Crypt.

title: Entry to Cliffside
text: As soon as you reach the main gate, go in the room next to it and speak to Gatekeeper Gostoc, take the opening path on the left, and work your way through the cliffside. Go out through the opening on the left and you'll see a summoning pool on the left corner which you can activate, and on the left side of the summoning pool is a body that you can pillage to find x1 Golden Rune (1). Turn around and hug the wall on the right, you'll see there's a concrete beam on the wall that you can jump on so that you can go through the opening. You'll then immediately see another body you can loot to find x3 Ruin Fragment.

Before you jump down towards the castle grounds, look to your right and you'll notice that the destroyed wall is formed like steps that you can jump on to reach the high ground that's on the upper left. When you reach it, there's another body by a wall that you can loot to find x1 Smithing Stone (2). After grabbing the upgrade material, make your way to the bottom to continue towards the castle. And just before heading forward, you'll find some items to loot on the west side where there are multiple Warhawk enemies.

title: Cliffside to Rampart Tower
text: Activate the Stormveil Cliffside Site of Grace, and when you are about to head up towards the wine cellar, grab the Marred Leather Shield from the corpse on the narrow platform. Continue inside the wine cellar and grab the Hookclaws from a corpse on the first level of the wine cellar. Be careful of the Commoner and Exile Soldier enemies here. Next, on the second level, you will see a hole in the wall that is covered in vines, jump on it and you can find a body that you can loot to find x10 St. Trina's Arrow. Head to the third floor and enter the treasure room on the right where you'll fight the Banished Knight. Defeat the enemy, make sure to loot the body since it may drop its equipment. In the same room, make sure to loot the corpse on the right side to find the Rusty Key, and inside the chest on the left is a x1 Curved Sword Talisman.

Use the key to open the locked door on the second floor of the wine cellar and climb the ladder to reach the upper level. Make sure to check the east side to find a Fire Grease and then head towards the west side and loot a Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot from another corpse as well. Head outside and take the steps that will take you to the ground level of the Rampart Tower. In the Rampart Tower, there is another Banished Knight enemy, on the second floor you'll find a checkpoint, and on the third floor and rooftop are more Exile Soldiers. At the rooftop section, jump onto the ledge of the balcony and maneuver your way to the opposite ledge that's at the northeast. You'll eventually drop into a shaft where you'll find a Stonesword Key from a corpse.

title: Rampart Towers to Liftside Chamber
text: Jump onto the rooftops where you will fight a Warhawk, then loot the nearby corpse to find a gesture x1 Dozing Cross-Legged. From the rooftops, look down, and you'll notice that there is a door that is blocked by a white fog. Work your way to get to the bottom by using the narrow ledges and use the Stonesword Key on the imp statue to dispel the fog. Enter the armory and kill the enemies and then loot the bodies here to find x1 Hawk Crest Wooden Shield, x1 Misericorde, and x1 Iron Whetblade. In the next room is a fortress of the Grafted Scion mini-boss. Head to the room adjacent to it to find a pile of corpses and a Troll that has been cut in half, hanging. Kill the Rotten Strays and loot the wrapped bodies to find three things here: x1 Lump of Flesh, x1 Chrysalids' Memento on top of the pile of bodies, and x1 Golden Rune (1).

Defeat the Grafted Scion and go east to find a set of stairs that goes to the second floor. There are Commoner, Exile Soldier enemies here, and inside the assembly room is a Banished Knight. Inside that room, you'll find a chest on the podium containing x1 Mimic's Veil. Follow the path ahead which is somehow linear until you find yourself outside where you'll encounter another Banished Knight and an Exile Soldier patrolling. Defeat the enemies to push through and you'll find the castle's chapel where Sorcerer Rogier is. Make sure to speak to him and exhaust his dialogue. From there, go back to the room where you fought the Grafted Scion and go west heading towards the stable and the castle's heavily guarded courtyard.

At the courtyard, make sure to take out the Exile Soldiers here one at a time since there is a lot and most of them are using ranged weapons. In the courtyard, there are some corpses you can loot to find x1 Magic Grease, x1 Golden Rune (1), x2 Golden Rune (2), x1 Pike1, and x5 Smoldering Butterfly. At the northeast side, there is a guardhouse, go up and loot the body to find x1 Wooden Greatshield. Head back down and at the center of the courtyard, you'll notice that there is an ogre enemy known as The Omen. Killing it yields Runes and you can loot the Omen Cleaver weapon, in the position where the ogre was, look to your left and you will see a study room and a glowing painting in the middle. Examine the painting to acquire the Prophecy Painting.

title: Liftside Chamber to the Courtyard and Godrick
text: Call the elevator and ride it inside the same room where the site of grace is and follow the linear path. Make sure to crouch and quietly sneak in since there is a Teardrop Scarab below. Killing it will drop the Ash of War: Stormcaller. After killing the scarab, go back up and look to the left side, you'll see another corpse in a sitting position that you can loot to find x8 Kukri - jump down and head towards the path ahead you'll find the Secluded Cell Site of Grace inside a small armory adjacent to it - you've also found the entrance leading to the main boss of this dungeon, which is the door that is covered with a golden fog-aura.

From the Secluded Cell checkpoint, you'll need to work your way through the courtyard to reach the main castle grounds which are heavily guarded, since there are a few more things to discover. Where the Troll is guarding the area near the Secluded Cell checkpoint, you can find a glowing branch tree to find x1 Golden Seed. There is a room nearby as well where you can find Nepheli. Make sure to speak to her and exhaust her dialogue so she can mention to summon her for aid before fighting Godrick the Grafted. Continue making your way to the main castle grounds and defeat the Exile Soldiers, and the mini-boss, the Lion Guardian.

title: After Godrick
text: Defeating Godrick yields x1 Godrick's Great Rune and x1 Remembrance of the Grafted, as well as 15000 Runes. After the battle, make sure to check the throne room ahead and go to the west side, head to the lower section and you'll immediately see a spirit NPC that looks like it's praying. Approach it and you can find an item next to it, pick it up to obtain x1 Shabriri Grape. If you turn back, you'll see a passage that goes outside, formally arriving at Liurnia of the Lakes. If you return to the Roundtable Hold, you'll find Nepheli Loux, the warrior who helped you in fighting Godrick, at the northeast side, by the library. Don't forget to speak to her so that she can give you x1 Arsenal Charm.

Now, if you want to use Godrick's Great Rune, you will need to fast travel to the Limgrave Tower Bridge site at Stormveil Castle. Work your way through the reanimated Colossal Statues, interact with the waygate portal and continue forward to reach the Divine Tower of Limgrave. Continue to the top until you reach the peak where you'll find a glowing sigil at the center. Approach and interact with it to restore the power of the great rune. Godrick's Great Rune blesses the player's character by raising all attributes.

title: Elden Ring Walkthrough - Liurnia of the Lakes: South
text: Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Liurnia of the Lakes (South) Points of Interest
Speak to some NPCs.
Clear out Malefactor's Evergaol.
Acquire some Important Items as you explore.
Find Patches and collect upgrade items for your Flasks.
Acquire the Academy Glintstone Key and explore Raya Lucaria Academy.
Optional: Fight the dragon, Glintstone Dragon Smarag.
Explore the Lakeside Crystal Cave

title: Speak to Boc the Seamster
text: Congratulations! You've completed the first of many Legacy Dungeons in Elden Ring, and you've beaten the first Demigod, Godrick the Grafted. If you were following our walkthrough for Stormveil Castle, you should formally arrive in Liurnia of the Lakes from the throne room of Godrick the Grafted. As soon as you enter the new region, you'll find the Lake-Facing Cliffs Site of Grace, examine it to discover the checkpoint, and if you were also following the walkthrough and have encountered Boc twice, you should find him here kneeling by the Lake-Facing Site of Grace, a cliff above to the entrance to Stillwater Cave. Make sure to talk to him and he'll offer to alter your armor. If he's not there when you first find the grace just rest.

title: The Wandering Maiden
text: You can also find Hyetta's initial location, found near the Lake-Facing Cliffs site of grace ( Elden Ring Map Link). But for her to show up, you must complete Irina's questline in the Weeping Peninsula, which is to deliver a letter to her father, Edgar who is at Castle Morne. Hyetta is initially found next to the Lake-Facing Cliffs site of grace. Hyetta says she roams The Lands Between in search of the distant light, drawn to her destiny by a guiding shine she feels in the back of her eyes when eating Shabriri Grapes. She will ask for one and if you choose to supply one to her, she will reward you with the As You Wish Gesture.

title: The Student of Raya Lucaria Academy
text: Next, if you move towards the southwest, you should find the Church of Irith ( Elden Ring Map Coordinates), it's easy to find and you'll meet a new NPC here named Thops, he is a student at the Academy of Raya Lucaria. You can find him sitting on a bench inside the destroyed church. By the statue, don't forget to grab the Sacred Tear material for your flask. As for Thops, if you speak to him, you can learn some spells from him in exchange for Runes. First, you must donate 10 Runes, and then you can learn some Sorcery spells from him.
Church of Irith Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

These are just basic spells, but if you are not playing as an Astrologer and if you need to but the basic sorcery like Glintstone Pebble, then you can learn it from Thops for 1000 Runes. Eventually, if you speak to him again, he will share that he wishes to return to the academy, this means you will need to find a second Academy Glintstone Key for him later on which can be found in the academy. This church has a graveyard section, you may want to check it to find some Warming Stone, an Academy Scroll. just be cautious since there are Skeleton enemies there.

title: Malefactor's Evergaol
text: Near the Church of Irith and the Lake-Facing Cliffs site, you can go northwest from the map to find the Malefactor's Evergaol ( Elden Ring Map Link). There is a mini-boss here, Adan, Thief of Fire who drops the Flame of the Fell God incantation spell and you can also find the Sacrificial Twig that can be found on a corpse on a stone platform jutting out of the cliff to the east. Accessible from above only, by heading east from Malefactor's Evergaol.
Malefactor's Evergaol Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

Unlike most evergaols, this one does not require a Stonesword Key to unlock. The transporter mechanism is active as soon as you reach the area. Enter the portal to challenge the boss imprisoned within Adan, Thief of Fire. Adan is a very straightforward fight. Despite his stout stature, he is quite agile and capable of quick dodge rolls. His main form of attack is his Flame of the Fell God spell, where he summons a large orb of fire that explodes after a short delay, dealing damage in a large radius and setting the area ablaze.

This attack is easy enough to avoid due to the clear telegraph and slow animation. He will also use a combo of multiple swings with his flail, ending in a spinning attack. This move has a long animation and can easily be exploited by ranged players.

title: Exploring the South Section
text: If you want to find a new set of Armor, you can find the Sage Set in the nearby cave of the Lake-Facing Cliffs site, Stillwater Cave. You can just run through and ignore the enemies if you can work your way around it. But if you are also aiming to clear out the cave, we recommend that you have a Torch to light up dark sections and to stock up with Neutralizing Boluses to alleviate the buildup and yo cure Poison. Stillwater Cave is inhabited by poison blooms and bats, and it is filled with poisonous miasma - it also has a mini-boss at the end, the Cleanrot Knight.

Stillwater Cave is a dark cave comprised of many pits where Poison Flowers and their giant counterparts bloom undisturbed. It is recommended to bring along a Torch and a handful of Neutralizing Boluses to counteract the poison build-up inflicted by its denizens. The Site of Grace is found shortly after entering the cave.
Stillwater Cave Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

The cave itself is rather small and there is a very straightforward path you can take to get to the boss: From the Site of Grace, hug the right wall and refrain from dropping down into the pits below as they are hotbeds for the Poison Flower enemies. There is a single Servant of Rot along the way. These are the mushroom-faced humanoids that cast poison bolts at targets from a distance. Take him out and jump the gap to reach the ledge ahead where two more servants await.

You can skip these if you are rushing to the boss. Hug the edge and head southeast until you see another servant around the bend. Jump down into the pit from here and run past all the Poison Flowers to find a tunnel in the southeast. This tunnel is filled with Servants of Rot but they are all in a rested state and will take a long time to get combat-ready, allowing you to simply weave around them to get to the mist gate at the end and challenge this dungeon's boss: The Cleanrot Knight.

The Cleanrot Knight is an imposing figure wielding a spear and a sword. After traversing through the mist gate, the boss will almost always run towards you and use his Impale attack. This is his most dangerous move and if the attack connects, he will raise you high in the air, deal tremendous amounts of damage and inflict the scarlet rot status on you. Dodge to the side when you see his spear glowing. Use your best spirit summons to distract him and take potshots at the knight from behind. Watch out for the water on the floor which will rapidly cause you to build up the poison stat. The Cleanrot Knight drops the Winged Sword Insignia upon defeat.

Stillwater Cave is a good source of Cave Moss should you require it for farming. Nearly every stretch of the cave has nodes of this material to collect from. Exploring the cave will also yield a good amount of Budding Cave Moss as well as Crystal Cave Moss crafting items. In general, the Giant Poison Flowers are not worth killing as they are highly resistant to magic and release a deadly poison at melee range. It's best to skip these while exploring the cave.

title: Finding Important Items in the Field
text: Once you're back to exploring the center section or south area of Liurnia, you'll want to grab a few items first and probably stop over some locations. We will be listing down the coordinates of the item and/or location marked on the Elden Ring Map so that you have a better picture of where the

Academy Scroll ( Elden Ring Map Link): It can be found just north of Church of Irith. It's by one of the big gravestones where the Skeleton Mages are rising. You can present this scroll to a sorcerer such as Sorceress Sellen so that you can gain access to additional Sorceries that you can learn. Sorceress Sellen is at Waypoint Ruins in Limgrave.
Map (Liurnia East) [ Elden Ring Map Link]: Found in the south of the swampy lake, in the middle by a monument with enlightened texts on it. A bit north from the Lake-Facing Cliffs site.

Laskyar Ruins ( Elden Ring Map Link): This ruins location can be found just a bit north of the monolith where you got the map fragment. You can find some useful items here such as a Ritual Pot, a Wraith Calling Bell, Smithing Stone [3], and the Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook (2). Don't forget as well to discover the site of grace for the ruins. In the middle of the ruin is a waygate that will take you right in front of the South Raya Lucaria Gate grace site, take it and unlock this site because you'll need it later.
Map (Liurnia North) [ Elden Ring Map Link]: This map fragment can be found just a bit south near the Academy Gate Town Site.
Golden Seed ( Elden Ring Map Link): You can find one by an illusory sapling. It can be found near the Academy Gate Town Site and the Academy Gate Town.

title: Patches, a Crystal Tear, a Church, and More Items!
text: If you travel northwest, open the map, and place a beacon on the small isle near the telescope. You'll find the Scenic Isle Site here ( Elden Ring Map Link). You will only find Patches here if you didn't kill him and decided to forgive him during your encounter with him at the Murkwater Cave in Limgrave. You can check his wares and purchase any items that you need. Continue moving northwest and you'll find another isle that has the Dexterity-knot Crystal Tear ( Elden Ring Map Link).

From the isle where you got the crystal tear, move west and you should find the Folly on the Lake Site. You can find it inside a gazebo, on the southwestern side of the lake ( Elden Ring Map Link). Travel north from this site and you should find the Rose Church. White-Faced Varre can be found in this location and if you exhaust his dialogue, you can acquire the Festering Bloody Finger. There are also some items that you can find here such as the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [12] and the Bloodflame Blade incantation that drops from a Teardrop Scarab found along the marshes outside of the nearby island. Note that there is another scarab nearby that does not drop anything.

Also from the Folly on the Lake Site, if you travel to the east, you should find the Boilprawn Shack ( Elden Ring Map Link). You can find the site for this location, as well as a new NPC, Blackguard Big Boggart. Make sure that you exhaust his lines and befriend him so he can be summoned later on for the Magma Wyrm Makar fight. Note, Blackguard Big Boggart will not speak with you beyond a line or two unless you speak with Rya first and she tells you about her stolen necklace. You first meet her at Liurnia of the Lakes under the pavilion next to the Birdseye Telescope north of Laskyar ruins. Exhausting her dialogue she will ask you to retrieve a necklace from someone who stole it.
You can visit Blackguard Big Boggart's page to learn more about his questline and to find a list of items that can be bought from him.

Now from the Rose Church, continue northwest and you should find the Temple Quarter ( Elden Ring Map Link). For this location, you can grab some materials such as Bloodrose and kill the Albinauric and Glintstone Flower enemies to farm Runes. In one of the destroyed buildings, however, there is a treasure chest containing the Icerind Hatchet weapon.

title: Find the Academy Glintstone Key
text: Now, the next legacy dungeon you will need to explore is the Raya Lucaria Academy, mainly found at the center of Liurnia of the Lakes region. The only way in is by passing through the South Raya Lucaria Gate which is actually blocked by a barrier and can only be entered if the person is holding the Academy Glintstone Key. If you were exploring and stumbled upon the South Raya Lucaria Gate through the Academy Gate Town ( Elden Ring Map Link) you should find a corpse of a Raya Lucaria Sorceror that's lying near the South Raya Lucaria Gate, if you loot the corpse, it holds the coordinates (Meeting Place Map - Elden Ring Map Link) for the Academy Glintstone Key.

The coordinates or location of the key will take you to a lake area that is guarded by the Glintstone Dragon Smarag. When you arrive, if you want to just grab the key, make sure you are riding your mount, and quickly run behind it. You'll see that it's guarding some corpses, the Raya Lucaria Sorcerer corpse holds the Academy Glintstone Key, while the other two holds a Dragonwound Grease and Kukri. The choice is yours if you want to fight this dragon or just avoid it - with the key, you can now enter Raya Lucaria Academy via the South Raya Lucaria Gate.

title: The Magical Dragon
text: Glintstone Dragon Smarag can be found due south of the Crystalline Woods site of grace, in central Liurnia of the Lakes. You will arrive at this location while exploring the lake area north of Temple District, he is usually asleep and guarding the Academy Glintstone Key, x6 Kukri, and a Dragonwound Grease ( Elden Ring Map Link). Regardless of class focus, get into your most highly protective gear against magic, fire (unknown which his breath attacks inflict), and physical and aim to execute the majority of the fight from horseback, getting off your steed only to gain I-frames, especially during his dive attack, an easy to prepare for attack because of the long buildup animation.

As often as possible try to hit Smarag's head. With enough pressure, he will go to the ground and open himself to a critical strike. Poise damage is minimally inflicted against the legs, wings, and torso, though Banished Knight Oleg's additional pressure against Smarag's flanks is enough to push the meter to full, so don't dismiss those areas of attack altogether. The majority of damage you will be able to inflict will be against the flanks and wings because Smarag so often holds his head out of reach, even with a double jump.

Most of Smarag's attacks will deal significant damage, but a vitality stat of 20+ should be enough to survive a single hit from any of his attacks. For a more detailed strategy and if you want to find our video guide on how to defeat this boss, check our Glintstone Dragon Smarag page - successfully defeating this dragon rewards you with 14,699 Runes and a Dragon Heart which you can use at the Church of Dragon Communion to learn unique Incantations - make further preparation after the battle as you make your way to Raya Lucaria Academy.

title: Lakeside Crystal Cave
text: This cave is located on South-Western Liurnia, carved among the cliffs by the shore ( Elden Ring Map Coordinates). It is also directly south from the Scenic Isle Site of Grace.
Lakeside Crystal Cave Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

After entering the cave you will find yourself in a large open area and in front of the grace is a chest containing an Arteria Leaf. Stick to your left and jump up the hill to clear out the Demi-Humans. Follow the pathway along the cliff as normal however, don't drop down into the chasm. Enter the room at the end of the cliff, kill the Demi-Human Chieftain inside the room and open the chest containing the Spear Talisman. Afterwards, head back and to the middle of the cliff to find an area to drop down to. Once you are at the bottom, you will enter a room containing 3 Crystal Snails and another room with many more, but these will take some time to attack. Drop down again to find Soft Cotton x2 on a body on the ledge and then drop down to grab a Smithing Stone (2), Smithing Stone (4) looted from two more corpses, and a Lump of Flesh. Once you proceed, you will get ambushed by three more snails. Turn left to fight the Boss, Bloodhound Knight. He is very agile and can close gaps quickly. Upon his Death he drops the Cerulean Amber Medallion.

After defeating the boss, continue through the arena to find the Slumbering Wolf's Shack. You can meet Latenna here and there is a Rune Arc behind the shack. After completing the Village of the Albinaurics later on in this walkthrough (Liurnia West), you can return to Latenna and she will accompany you as spirit ashes.

title: Elden Ring Walkthrough - Raya Lucaria Academy
text: Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Raya Lucaria Academy Points of Interest
Find the Academy Glintstone Key to pass through the gate's barrier.
Investigate the two bridges leading to the academy's main gate.
Explore the academy.
Defeat the Monolith Guardian.
Collect the Carian Knight Set.
Fight the Red Wolf of Radagon.
Keep an eye out for Crystallized Crabs.

Academy of Raya Lucaria
Liurnia of the Lakes
Red Wolf of Radagon ◆ Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon

The Academy of Raya Lucaria is a Legacy Dungeon in Elden Ring. Quite a different area as it has a variety of blue hues, compared to the green open spaces of Limgrave, covered in crystals not only in its environment but also the creatures that inhabit it. These range from snails to more vicious animals to the underwater crustaceans such as crabs and are heavily guarded by the academy's scholars.

links.text: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon

markers.text: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon

title: Academy Gate Town
text: As you take out the enemies in this section, don't forget to grab a Smithing Stone (3) that can be looted from the ground. Continue moving north through the enemies to reach the gate or you can go around it by moving east where you'll find a corpse that you can loot to find 4x Glintstone Fireflies - the end of this path is where you'll find the South Raya Lucaria Gate Site of Grace and the entrance to the academy, when you're ready, go through the sigil of the gate. Important: If you do not see the prompt to pass through the sigil, try standing under the sigil itself rather than against the physical gate.

title: Entering the Academy of Raya Lucaria
text: Go back, and head up the stairs where you'll see two Glintstone Sorcerers at the top, be mindful when you are fighting these enemies since they can use sorcery and bombard you with glintstone sorcery from afar; use your shield, time your dodges right, or even close the gap and attack them with your melee weapon since they react slow towards close-quarter combat. Kill the two Glintstone Sorcerers and open the door to continue onto the next section, the Church of the Cuckoo.

You can easily spot them if you look up and press the auto-lock button. Upon clearing the section, make sure to check behind the altar, there is a wall, and behind it is a corpse that you can loot to find a Somber Smithing Stone (3), while on the right side, resting against a wall, is another corpse that has a Golden Rune (2). Before Moving on there is also a hidden room on the right side as you enter. The first wall segment on the right side is an Illusory Wall. Break the illusion to reveal a small side area filled with stone coffins. On the other end of the area is a corpse with a Rune Arc. Now, there is another room that you can find on the left side that has the Church of the Cuckoo Site of Grace, just turn left as you pass through the arch doorway to find it - activate it and rest if needed.

title: Academy Graveyard
text: While on the left side of the arch doorway, you'll see a path that is lit with a torch, down the slope, you'll find a Teardrop Scarab, kill it to obtain x1 Ash of War: Spectral Lance. If you continue going down the slope, you'll see another corpse that you can loot that is being guarded by another Putrid Corpse. Kill the enemy and loot the corpse at the end of the slope to find x1 Golden Rune (4) - retrace your steps back to the arch doorway and pass through the hall.

By the arch doorway, look to your right and you'll see a slope that goes up, to a corner, there is another Wandering Nobles with a torch here, kill it and walk up a bit, on the right side, there's a body hanging by the ledge, loot it to find a Golden Rune (4) - after grabbing the Golden Rune, go back down and head through the arch doorway where you'll find the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace.

Now go back where you left the rotating lift. Turn left and kill a Wandering Noble at the end to take the lift going down. Take off when you see the ground sticking out. Defeat the group containing 2 Avionette Soldiers and Wandering Nobles to get the Avionette Soldier Ashes.

title: The Great Hall
text: We suggest that you kill both sorcerers first and then shift your attention towards the Lazuli Sorcerer. Upon defeating the enemies on the second floor, walk towards the balcony with large arc-looking statue, look to the left, and you'll see a corpse that's hanging by the balcony's fence, loot it to find x1 Furlcalling Finger Remedy - you've cleared the second floor.

Secret Wall: Upon reaching the top of the stairs (just before the boss room door), the first empty bookshelf on the left of the staircase is an illusionary wall. See picture below. This leads to a chest containing the spell Comet and a corpse behind the altar containing a Stonesword Key. Climb the ladder in this room and make your way to the terrace along the back wall. There is a hole that will drop you into another room containing the Graven-School Talisman. The pots will come alive once you approach the talisman.

title: Greater Enemy: Red Wolf of Radagon
text: During our encounter with this mini-boss, at the start of the battle, we used the Lone Wolf Ashes to summon three wolves to help in combat. They help in attacking the Red Wolf, and most importantly, they can catch its attention, allowing our character to attack it with ranged magical attacks while it is busy fighting the wolves. The wolf has low health and it is slightly weak against Slash Damage and/or Pierce Damage.

This either happens when it uses a lunging bite attack, this move usually has a max of three hits, and after the third lunge, you can counterattack. Another will be after it leaps into the air and lands on the ground with the magical sword in its mouth, there is a chance for you to land one to two hits before it fully recovers. Just don't be greedy and remember to back away after landing your counters - as you defeat this greater enemy, it rewards you with 14000 Runes and x1 Memory Stone, you'll also find the Debate Parlor Site of Grace in this arena.

title: Courtyard
text: If you check around as well, there are some materials that you can grab such as Rowa Fruit, Herba, and Trina's Lily. If you check the northwest section of the courtyard, you'll encounter a Giant Crab that will burrow out from the ground. Killing it yields Runes and drops x1 Crab Eggs. Head west of the courtyard and you'll see a glowing sapling that is guarded by three Wandering Nobles. Kill the enemies and check the glowing sapling to find x1 Golden Seed on the ground.

Go back to where the glowing sapling is and check the right-side corner where you'll spot a corpse that you can loot. Tread carefully as you approach it since a Giant Crab will ambush you from the ground. Kill the enemy and loot to the body to find x1 Golden Rune (2). Also near this body, if you go check the ledge of the cliff on the left side of the body, there's another corpse that you can pillage to find x1 Golden Rune (4).

title: Academy Rooftops
text: Sprint across the group of Wandering Nobles, up the stairs, and take out the two sorcerers first. Remember that they react slowly when you close the gap and fight them upfront. Next, kill the Wandering Noble, which has a chance to drop Aristocrat Coat, and kill the rest of the Wandering Nobles. Go back down and head up the steps opposite to it where you'll encounter more Wandering Nobles and another Glintstone Sorcerer. Clear this area and loot the nearby corpse to find x1 Golden Rune (2). Next, go back and head towards the arch doorway that was in front of the group of kneeling Wandering Nobles. You'll find an office where you can loot a body that is hanging on the fence of the window balcony - the body contains x1 Glintstone Whetblade.

Looking up, you will notice a corpse on the roof. To reach it, jump down once more and look to your left. There is another roof with a fair amount of gap but still reachable. Perform a careful running jump to step onto the roof and prepare for an immediate ambush a Avionette Soldier. Head left and follow the spiral path of rooftops, inhabited by several Marionette Soldiers. After a jump over a gap once again, you will see a ladder on your left. Just don't go into the ladder room naively since two Marionette Soldiers are each looking for an ambush from the left and right wall. The ladder leads to the top of a bell tower, in which you can obtain the Full Moon Crossbow. Now jump down to a rooftop, on the left of which you will see the forementioned corpse bearing a Smithing Stone (4).

Jump down from the corpse and you are back to where you were before. Do the hard jump again, but this time, go straight to perform another jump. Go to the tower that you see on your right; an Avionette Soldier will ambush in the middle. Go down through broken wooden floors until you see a Crystallized Crab, which can be looted for the Lazuli Glintstone Crown. Eventually, you will reach a small room with some crabs and a body holding a Somber Smithing Stone (4).

Leaving the room, go around to your left to climb the ladder. On your left, you will see a body that you can loot to find x1 Imbued Sword Key inside a tower. Looking across from the key, and you'll see a nearby narrow platform of another towering building. Jump across and go around the platform to find another body that's sitting by the edge, to pillage and acquire x2 Smithing Stone (3).

Retrace your steps back to the ladder to see two Marionette Soldier enemies roaming the rooftops north of you. Jump across the rooftop in front of the ladder. Move North, and then look to your right, there's a dead-end by the rooftop where you'll see a corpse that can be pillaged to acquire x2 Magic Grease. Just be careful since two Avionette Soldiers will ambush you.

Jump down onto the short bridge from the chandelier and tread carefully since the upper section of the church is guarded by Lazuli Sorcerers and Glintstone Sorcerers. Check the northwest side after killing the enemies to find a corpse that is sitting against a wall, you can pillage the body to find x1 Shattering Crystal. Make sure to kick the ladder down that's at the opposite side of the short bridge, this unlocks a shortcut leading back to the Church of the Cuckoo site of grace (take note that the enemies here respawn). Head east to see an arch doorway and a balcony, each at the end of a bridge.

You can go again to the rooftop area to get a missing item, Golden Rune (4), but probably you will just want to skip it. To reach it, go to the roof where you had to make a hard jump over the big gap. Go straight this time and at the very bottom, you'll encounter another Marionette Soldier on the right side. Kill it and continue west where you'll see another Marionette Soldier roaming the narrow rooftop. Jump across the next rooftop and you'll see another body here that you can loot to pick up x1 Golden Rune (4).

title: Grand Library Outskirts
text: He can also use a flask to recover his health, and he can use a great amount of it. So apart from trying to be careful with fighting this knight, you will need to apply pressure by quickly attacking to stop him from healing. Now, we did discover one tactic that you can exploit. Bait and lead him towards the entrance of the doorway where the iron ball trap is. He will follow you, but not all the way. He will, however, keep walking side to side by the door and back inside, and he will wait for you to approach him. Remain at the sides of the stairs as you hug the fence to avoid getting hit by the iron ball and bombard him with ranged attacks when he's within your sight - successfully defeating this hostile NPC drops x1 Carian Knight's Shield.

From the garden where Moongrum was initially standing, straight ahead is a lift that you can ride to reach the upper level leading to the boss, while the left side of the courtyard goes down to a garden. This is guarded by a Glintstone Sorcerer and Wandering Noble. Go straight through the garden and unlock the door that serves as a shortcut back to the courtyard.
Once you are ready, ride the lift to the top where you'll find doors leading to Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

markers.text: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon

title: Facing Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
text: This is why summoning the wolves is a good tactic since they'll just randomly run around attacking the children, and if you're lucky enough, if they spot one that is hiding, it can just attack it once, and you can find the next host. There is also one moment in combat that you will need to be aware of, when she speaks and says something about her children being born anew, get ready to get behind the bookshelves or stack of books since she will use them as projectiles to attack you.

Take note that every time she summons a spirit, white glyphs will appear on the ground that deals damage and can knock you down if you are caught or step on it. Defeating her yields 40000 Runes and rewards you with x1 Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen and x1 Great Rune of the Unborn.

title: Speed Run Walkthrough
text: To enter Raya Lucaria Academy, you must have an Academy Glintstone Key to pass through the barrier. To find it, grab the map that has the coordinates of the key or travel to an island that is situated on the west side from the academy. On that island, you'll find that it is guarded by a field boss, the Glintstone Dragon Smarag. Fighting this dragon is optional since you can simply sneak behind it and loot the key from a lucarian sorcerer corpse. Once you have it, return to the South Raya Lucaria Gate and you can pass through the barrier. The nearest site of grace is the Crystalline Woods site Map Coordinates.

At the Academy Gate Town Site of Grace, check the northeast section and you can find a glowing sapling where you can pick up x1 Golden Seed Map Coordinates Here, next, go west and you'll see a Giant Crab that you can kill, this drops x1 Crab Eggs. At the same section where the Giant Crab was, you'll find a body that can be looted to find x3 Smithing Stone (2) Map Coordinates Here. In the same section, look behind and you'll see a couple of Land Squirts, and above it is a Teardrop Scarab hanging on the wall. Killing the Teardrop Scarab drops Ash of War: Charge Forth.

Upon entering the academy and finding the Church of the Cuckoo Site of Grace, you'll be exploring the graveyard section that's infested with Putrid Corpses. When you cross the wooden bridge, at the other end, make a hard left and drop down to the path below. Circle around where you'll encounter two Marionette Soldiers. In front of it is a body that you can loot to find Marionette Soldier Ashes. Continue through the graveyard, but as you reach the doorway that leads into the next section, go left and you'll find a path that is lit with a torch. You'll see another Teardrop Scarab there, kill it to acquire the Ash of War: Spectral Lance.

Head through the doorway to enter the next section where you'll find a large rotating lift. By the entrance, turn right, hug the wall, and drop down to the path below. Walk along the narrow path and you'll see another group of Putrid Corpses that are worshipping a large tombstone, kill the group and pick up the glowing item near the tombstone to find the Carian Knight Set. Go back to the section where the large rotating lift is, don't ride it yet, but instead go straight where you'll see some maiden statues and a monlith at the center. Defeat the Slender Wayfarer that is guarding the monolith to acquire the Gravity Well sorcery and pick up the smithing stone on the monolith.

Next, ride the lift and head to the lower-most section where you'll encounter a Pendulum Statue enemy. Defeat it and make sure to loot the corpse here to find the Longtail Cat Talisman. Ride the lift again and head to the top section, kill the enemies along the way and enter the next section where you can find the Schoolhouse Classroom site. From the site, enter the hallway and go to the room on the left. There's a corpse that you can loot to find the Conspectus Scroll and a treasure chest containing the Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [5].

Don't leave the room yet, in front of the body you just looted, make sure to hit the door in front of it to reveal the illusory wall. Pillage the body on the right of the balcony to find a Smithing Stones and then jump off the balcony from the left side. Grab the materials there and follow the narrow sideway, along the way, before jumping down and returning to the Schoolhouse Classroom site, there's a body that can be looted to find the Olivinus Glintstone Crown. Now continue exploring the hallway.

Take note that the Glintstone Sorcerer has a chance to drop the Academy Glintstone Staff. At the other end of the hallway where you encountered the giant Living Jar, you'll find a chest containing x1 Ritual Pot. On the second floor that is guarded by more Glintstone Sorcerers, make sure to check the balcony to find another corpse that can be pillaged to acquire Furlcalling Finger Remedy - head up the third floor, and if you are prepared, pass through the mist to fight Red Wolf of Radagon.

Defeating Red Wolf of Radagon rewards you with 14000 Runes and x1 Memory Stone, you'll also find the Debate Parlor Site of Grace in this arena. As you exit through the doorway, you'll enter the main courtyard of the institue. From the entrance, turn right and jump over the fence. Climb up the ladder and go through the broken glass window to reach the second floor of the Debate Parlor. Go to the left, and you'll find a body that you can pillage to find x5 Crystal Bud. Head to the opposite side on the right, and you'll find a treasure chest containing x1 Radagon Icon. Head back down and start exploring the courtyard section.

On the fountain, you can find x1 Stonesword Key. Make sure to go around the courtyard to find some materials. Head west of the courtyard and you'll see a glowing sapling that is guarded by three Wandering Nobles. Kill the enemies and check the glowing sapling to find x1 Golden Seed on the ground. Also on the west, there's a Cryallized Crab hiding around the corner, by the bush, kill it to acquire x1 Karolos Glintstone Crown.

After clearing the west side of the courtyard, return to the center area where the fountain is and you'll see a slope on the right (facing the doorway leading back to the Debate Parlor). At the top, there are multiple enemies here such as more Glintstone Sorcerers and Wandering Nobles. You'll see the Wandering Nobles kneeling, a Wandering Noble standing on the steps, two Glintstone Sorcerers standing by the balcony fence at the top of the steps, while another sorcerer inside the room in front of the kneeling Wandering Nobles. Kill all the enemies and go inside the small room to find a body that is hanging on the fence of the window balcony - the body contains x1 Glintstone Whetblade.

Now traverse the rooftops section of the academy. Make sure to check every corner and some platforms that you can jump on or can drop to find some materials. There's x1 Imbued Sword Key as well that can be looted off a body located on another towering building. Eventually, you'll end up finding a broken glass window that leads to the ceiling of the Church of the Cuckoo. Loot the body that's on the narrow beam and drop down until you land on the chandelier where you can take another Academy Glintstone Key from the corpse.

Jump down to the second floor and clear the area of Lazuli Sorcerers and Glintstone Sorcerers. Check the northwest side after killing the enemies to find a corpse that is sitting against a wall, you can pillage the body to find x1 Shattering Crystal. Head east, out the balcony, and check the right side by the corner of the scaffolding to find another Crystallized Crab, kill it to acquire the Twinsage Glintstone Crown. Also, there's another doorway here that is guarded by a single soldier. Inside the room that is being guarded, you'll find the Azur's Glintstone Staff on the ground - after clearing the second floor, make sure to kick the ladder to unlock a shortcut to the Church of the Cuckoo site.

Go back to the courtyard and go east where you'll encounter the large iron ball trap. Make sure to loot the bodies on the stairs and the broken beam to find items such as x8 Crystal Dart, x1 Smithing Stone (5) and x1 Furlcalling Finger Remedy. As you enter the next section, you'll encounter a hostile enemy NPC, Moongrum, Carian Knight that's guarding the lift leading to the main boss of this legacy dungeon. Defeating Moongrum drops the Carian Knight's Shield. Before riding the lift, check the west side, by the gate, turn left and jump over the fence as you walk on the narrow beam of the wall. Climb up the ladder, defeat the Lesser Pumpkin Head and Glintstone Sorcerers. There's a treasure chest that you can open to find x1 Glintstone Scarab - climb back down, open the closed door and ride the lift.

One of the items you've found in the academy is the Academy Glintstone Key. If you have both Keys, the second can to be given to Thops who can be found at the Church of Irith. Map Link. Just make sure that you were able to buy everything that you need from him before or after giving him the key. Upon giving the key, if you travel to the Schoolhouse Classroom site of grace of the academy, you'll find him dead outside the room. Go outside and turn right, you'll find him, sitting in a chair. You can loot his body to find x1 Thops's Bell Bearing, x1 Thops's Barrier, and x1 Academy Glintstone Staff.

title: Elden Ring Walkthrough - Liurnia of the Lakes: East
text: Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Liurnia of the Lakes (East) Points of Interest
Clear out Cliffbottom Catacombs.
Examine the Highway Lookout Tower.
Travel to the Church of Vows.
Visit the Minor Erdtree of Northeast Liurnia.
Complete Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel.
Investigate Ainsel River (Underground).

title: Cliffbottom Catacombs in Liurnia
text: Cliffbottom Catacombs Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

Once you've cleared Raya Lucaria Academy, it's time to explore the east side of the map for Liurnia of the Lakes, we recommend that you start from the Lake-Facing Cliffs Site and work your way up. The Cliffbottom Catacombs can be found a bit northeast of the mentioned site ( Elden Ring Map Link). Cliffbottom Catacombs is a catacomb that is filled with imps and ogres, Walk carefully to not wake or alert the ogres or get jumped on by the imps. The catacombs also have multiple buttons on the floor that trigger traps that shoot projectiles at the player, use them to your advantage by triggering them to hit enemies. The imps in this dungeon will throw a blue pot explosion at players - this location is good to find upgrade materials such as Grave Glovewort [2] and Grave Glovewort [3] that are used to strengthen your Spirit Ashes with the help of Roderika.

Leaving the Site of Grace going down the stairs you will see the elevator room, step on the button to lower yourself down. A lever is present at the top and bottom of the shaft for you to call the elevator if it is not there. The first room after the elevator has 2 imps, one on the wall ahead and one standing on the right of the entrance. Past this room is the pair of locked doors flanked by 2 statues, the door will be unlocked by a lever found deep in the catacombs.

Stepping into the rest of the catacombs you will walk into a square room with a staircase, the stairs lead downwards going over a pit where an ogre can be seen sitting. Going forward into the next tunnel be careful of both the floor trap as well as the imp in the ceiling, there is another imp on the corner ahead that will jump you so be prepared for it.

Through this tunnel, you enter into a room with a high ceiling, and some stairs leading up on the left side, straight ahead there is a sleeping ogre between the pillars, kill it to get to the grave glovewort behind it. Up the stairs are a sealed door and an imp statue but also another ogre, this time awake and patrolling, above them are a pair of imps ready to throw grenades at you if you catch their attention. You could either rush the imps by going up the stairs and ignoring the ogre or kite the ogre down the stairs to separate the imps and the ogre to make for an easier fight.

The room sealed by the Imp statue will require a Stonesword Key to open, you will find 1 imp enemy and the Nox Mirrorhelm. Go up the stairs and carefully deal with the 2 imps in this room, a floor trap is placed right at the entrance to the room which can be used to shoot projectiles into one of the imps. Following the path out of this room, you will find yourself in the space above the initial set of stairs and entrance. There are multiple imps in this area and in the room on the left you can find 3 imps, the body there holds the scythe for you to loot.

To proceed to the lever, you have to drop down into the room under the first set of stairs leading from the locked doors. This part of the catacombs has multiple ogres roaming the halls so tread carefully. Moving around the tunnels here you can find remains with loot on them, one of which is the Prattling Pate "Wonderful".

From the room you dropped down into go east to advance, there you will find a single ogre blocking the way forward, kill them to proceed. At the end of these tunnels is a ladder, climb it to find a room with a carpet and some bookshelves. On the left, you will find an ogre looking at a tomb in front of a stone statue, going right will lead you to the lever and the way back to the start. On the tomb is the Page Ashes.

This fight is against a variant version of the Erdtree Burial Watchdog that uses a staff, spells, and has 3 heads that will do a 3 headed fire breathing attack. The fight is against just the boss without any additional enemies. The boss still uses the same movement pattern as the normal Erdtree Burial Watchdog, in their seated form floating up and towards the player before stomping down and walking towards the player to slam and slamming that down while in their standing form. While seated the Erdtree Burial Watchdog will also cast spells at players, breathing flames at them or casting seeking glintstone sorceries. Defeating this boss will reward you with Kaiden Sellsword Ashes and 3200 Runes.

title: The Wandering Maiden... Again.
text: After clearing the Cliffbottom Catacombs, from this location, head northwest and you should find the Purified Ruins. You can find items such as another Sabriri Grape, a Golden Rune [3], a Cuckoo Glinstone, and the Two Fingers Heirloom talisman. Since you have another Shabriri Grape, you'll find Hyetta on the western side of the Purified Ruins. She asks for another Shabriri Grape but does not give any reward this time. Continue going north and you'll encounter the Purified Ruins Waygate that teleports you to the entrance of Raya Lucaria Academy ( Elden Ring Map Link) - next, make sure to discover the Liurnia Highway North Site, found on the side of the main road ( Elden Ring Map Link)

title: Highway Lookout Tower
text: Just a bit northwest from the Liurnia Highway North Site, stopover the Highway Lookout Tower ( Elden Ring Map Link) This tower is situated up a hill and is heavily guarded by specters of Noble Sorcerers and Noble Wanderers, as well as a Twinsage Sorcerer that can be found at the top floor of the tower. We recommend that you traverse the barricades while you are riding your mount since the specters will spawn as soon as you try to push through and the sorcerer at the top of the tower will start shooting sorcery projectiles at you. Climb up the ladder and loot the chest for a Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook (3). Head up two more ladders, kill the sorcerer, and loot the corpse beside the enemy to find the Carian Glintblade Staff.

After clearing the location, climb back down and continue moving a bit northwest as you follow the road which takes you to the site of the Gate Town Bridge ( Elden Ring Map Link). If you spoke to Hyetta earlier, you should find her here as well ( Elden Ring Map Link Hyetta Third Location). Hyetta spawns near the site of grace. She will ask for another Shabriri Grape and will ask what the grapes are. Telling her will make her puke and then thank you for telling her. After sitting down at the grace nearby she will have more dialog. After once again sitting at the grace she will move to her next location.

Now, if you want to challenge yourself and if you want a new Ashes of War, then rest until nightfall by the site and you'll find the Night's Cavalry field boss here. This field boss can be found patrolling near the Gate Town Bridge, again, only appears at night, and it drops the Ash of War: Ice Spear if you defeat it. You can visit our Night's Cavalry page to find a written strategy, as well as a video guide on how to defeat this field boss.

Next, from the Gate Town Bridge site ( Elden Ring Map Link), head east to beat the Tibia Mariner field boss. For (1) Mounted Combat, the strategy here is pretty straightforward. You ride up to the boss and hit him several times, then ride away before he hits you with his attacks. You can ignore his minions entirely as they tend to move slowly and don't hit that hard. It also makes it easy to get back to him when he vanishes and reappears. (2) Melee Combat, clear the minions first if you plan to play on foot so you don't get overwhelmed. Hit the boss a few times and then dodge to the side when he raises and splashes down. Keep repeating this, staying to his side or behind him if you can. If he disappears and reappears track him down and repeat. And (3) Magic and Ranged Users, much like melee, clear the minions first and then proceed to range the boss down with attacks. He moves slowly so you don't need to reposition very often.

Successfully defeating this boss drops a Deathroot and the Skeletal Bandit Ashes. Nearby, you'll notice a location, the Carian Study Hall, ignore that for now since it cannot yet be completed as you are missing a key item you will obtain later from this NPC.

links.text: Elden Ring Map Link Hyetta Third Location

title: Travel to the Church of Vows
text: The road north has two paths: One has a Golem that is guarding access to Ainsel River Well. Ignore this, for now, you'll check this later on. Take the other path up the slopes. The area to the left of the site of grace will have an Incantation (Flame, Cleanse Me!) and the Fire Monk Gauntlets. Stay the road and access the higher ground to arrive at the Church of Vows ( Elden Ring Map Link and meet Miriel, Pastor of Vows who can teach you both Incantations and Sorceries, receive Scrolls and Prayerbooks, and give you information about the Lore of major characters.

This location is important because it allows you to cleanse your SIN (aggro'd NPCs) by using Celestial Dew and performing an "Absolution" at the altar. Make sure to discover and rest at the site of grace for the Church of Vows. And grab some items such as the Golden Tailoring Tools and the Gold Sewing Needle inside a chest. There is another field boss here that roams around the church at night, and this is the Bell Bearing Hunter. If you successfully defeat this boss, you'll be rewarded with the Meat Peddler's Bell Bearing.

title: Minor Erdtree Northeast Liurnia
text: Before you proceed to the next location, make sure to rest and prepare since you will encounter another boss at the next location. From the Church of Vows, travel northeast and you should find the Minor Erdtree of Liurnia Northeast, along the way is also the Ruined Labyrinth Site, don't forget to discover it. When you arrive, you'll encounter the Erdtree Avatar for this location. You'll want to defeat this field boss to acquire the following Physick Flask Buffs: the Lightning-Shrouding Cracked Tear, Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear, and the Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear.

Next, move southwest or go back to the Ruined Labyrinth Site, on the west side you should find a Walking Mausoleum ( Elden Ring Map Link). To identify if you're near, players will hear mausoleums as they emit a distinctly loud bell sound as they walk about. They usually have a small roaming area, so they are easy to find. When you want to take on a walking mausoleum, you must attack its deposits until it comes down. This can take considerable time depending on the location.

Once the mausoleum is static, you can enter it at any time to perform a Remembrance Duplication: This is only available once per mausoleum, so pick wisely! Performing this rite will enable you to obtain the multiple Remembrance Weapons (Boss Weapons) and magic that they grant. Boss Armor is not gated behind their remembrances, but you must have defeated them to purchase from Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

title: More Smithing Stones for You!
text: At this point, you'll be needing more Smithing Stones to properly upgrade your armaments, lucky for you, there is a nearby cave here where you can gather the materials you need. From the Ruined Labyrinth Site, travel west and you should find the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel. This area is similar to Limgrave Tunnels where you will need to explore the tunnel paths, gather the stones you need, fight the enemies and reach the boss at the end, the Crystalians.
Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

When first entering the mine, you'll find an elevator. Going down it will put you in front of the Site of Grace for this area. On the way down the elevator, you might notice two doorways on the left side of the wall. If you want to reach these, go back up the elevator and destroy the boxes on the left, right before you get on the elevator then jump down. Be careful because if you fall you will die. In the first doorway, you will find x1 Cracked Crystal. Following the ledge left drop-down and enter the next doorway. You'll get 3 Cracked Crystals. Continue following the ledges down. There are lamps to guide you. At the bottom of the elevator, before you head through the doorway, look behind you and grab the x2 Cracked Crystal that are in the corners.

Heading through the tunnel in front of the elevator will lead you to a fork in the path. Going right will bring you to a chest guarded by two Diggers, one of which will patrol the area. Inside the chest, you'll find Somber Smithing Stone (2) 1x. You can grab 4 Cracked Crystals from this room. Also, behind the chest is a statue on an elevated rock. Jump up the right side and you'll find a Somber Smithing Stone (3) 1x behind the statue. Going to the left will lead you to an open area with one Digger on the left and three on the right. One of the Diggers on the right is patrolling the area while the other two are mining. You'll notice a support beam in the area. If you cross it, you can jump on the wooden ledges that are jutting out. Near the top grab the Smithing Stone [3]. At the top, you'll find a corpse with one Somber Smithing Stone [3]. This room holds six Cracked Crystals.

In the next room, looking to the right you'll notice another Digger sitting down. Down the first set of stairs are two more Diggers who are also sitting down. They will attack you when you near them, just like the previous one who was sitting. After killing them look to your right. You should see a Digger and a path that leads to a small room. Be careful when attacking the Digger outside of it because one from beneath the stairs will attack you. The small room holds 2 Smithing Stone [3].

One on a wall to the left and one on a corpse to the right. Going behind the stairs you'll find a corpse with 1 Golden Rune [3]. This room contains a total of sixteen Cracked Crystals and one Smithing Stone [3] excluding the 2 Smithing Stones found earlier. Exiting this room leads you to an elevator with more ledges. Just like last time, stick to the left. You'll find a tunnel that leads to a ledge. On the right grab the Somber Smithing Stone [2] and the x2 Cracked Crystal. Go back to the elevator and stick to the left as you jump down.

Following the tunnel out connects you to a cavern with another support beam and another elevator. Before crossing the beam, kill the Digger on your left and grab the Smithing Stone [2]. After crossing the beam, kill the patrolling Digger but don't go up the stairs. Instead, go to the right of them and grab the Smithing Stone [3]. Go up the stairs and kill the other Digger that is patrolling, then take the elevator up so you have a shortcut if you die. This room holds eight Cracked Crystals, one Smithing Stone [3], and one Smithing Stone [2] minus what I already mentioned.

Be careful going through the tunnel leading out because a Marionette soldier will run out of the room to your right and attack you with four daggers. Kill him quickly if possible. Before going into the room they came out of, look at the other doorway and look up. You'll notice two more Marionette soldiers hanging waiting to attack you. Getting close will make them fall. Both have two bows each and can be annoying if not dealt with quickly. The room the first Marionette soldier came out of holds one Smithing Stone [2].

Going through the other doorway where the two Marionette soldiers dropped down from leads you to another section with two doors. As soon as you pass the doorway on the right look up and you'll see another Marionette soldier wielding bows. They won't drop down until you attack them or the other two Marionette soldiers in the room. The two on the ground both wield daggers and are guarding a chest. Kill them then the archer if you haven't yet. The chest holds a Crystal Knife.

Go through the doorway that has a tunnel in view. The first level has no enemies on it. Go down the first set of stairs and kill the Digger. After you killed him look to the left. You should see three Diggers in a circle and two Crystal Sorcerers. Take out the sorcerers first. They have more health than the Diggers and the Diggers here won't attack you unless you attack them first. After dealing with the sorcerers, kill the three Diggers in a circle and collect the three Smithing Stone [3] and the Somber Smithing Stone [1]. There are two more Diggers in this area. After killing them all (if you want to) you can collect the eight Cracked Crystals, the Smithing Stone [2], and the Smithing Stone [3]. The last two smithing stones can be found in the collapsed tunnel in the back of the room. On your way out (looking left from the second platform leading down) there is a tunnel leading to a room with a corpse holding the Shatter Earth spell.

The tunnel in front of the stairs leads you to an elevator. To the left of it, after you break the items there, jumping down will lead you to a small tunnel with a Somber Smithing Stone [3]. Once at the bottom of the elevator you'll sell the golden boss fog. If you want to go back to the Site of Grace to rest and take the elevators you found along the way down.

This boss is the Crystalian. Its moves are easy to predict, and you can summon spirits to help you. At the beginning of the fight, it's likely you won't be doing much damage. I was only doing 5-9 damage. Just keep dodging, blocking, and attacking the boss. Be sure to not get hit because it'll hurt. I didn't truly start damaging them till I staggered them then followed up with a critical blow. After that their health was around half. Getting hit with one of her throwing blades seemed to cause one resembling it to show around my wrist allowing me to do full damage (158-400). If you want to find more guides for this boss, visit our Crystalians page - defeating this boss drops 3000 Runes and the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing (1) - turn this into the Twin Maiden Husks and you can now buy Smithing Stone [1] and Smithing Stone [2] with runes as long as you can afford them - now fast travel back to the Eastern Tableland Site and proceed to Ainsel River Well.

There are also some other locations you may want to visit in the east map for Liurnia.Please note that if you've been following the walkthrough from the beginning, at this point there's not an easy way for you to reach the northern section of the area to access these locations, unless you want to do some fancy wall-climbing with Torrent and it is tedious and best left for later when you get easier access to these areas. But if want to attempt, following the steps below.

Directly northeast of the Erdtree Avatar that you found earlier, there is a short stone spire next to the impassible wall. Your goal here is to use Torrent's double jump and to get to the top of that spire, then jump directly northeast to the small edges of the impassible rock wall and climb up to the northern section.
It's recommended that you kill Erdtree Avatar before attempting this, because it will constantly grief you, making this next to impossible.
After you reach the northern section, go north to reach the Frenzied Flame Village Outskirts site of grace to activate it, avoiding having to do the jump-climb again.
The northern parts of this area will now be accessible to explore the following:

Converted Fringe Tower ( Elden Ring Map Link): A tower that requires a puzzle to be solved in order to unlock it. The top of the tower is sealed by a puzzle. Read the message at the foot of the statue to find out what the puzzle is. To clear the puzzle, perform the Erudition gesture while wearing any Glintstone Crown in front of the door. The Hiama Glintstone Crown does not work for this.
Church of Inhibition ( Elden Ring Map Link): There is an NPC invader her, Festering Fingerprint Vyke. Defeat the hostile NPC to enter the church where you can find the Finger Maiden Set.

Frenzied Flame Village ( Elden Ring Map Link): Just a bit northwest from the Minor Erdtree. You can find items here such as Shabriri's Woe, looted off a body at the edge of the Frenzied Flame Village, and the Frenzied's Cookbook [1], looted off a corpse inside one of the houses in the village.

Black Knife Catacombs ( Elden Ring Map Link): This area is good to gather glovewort flowers used to upgrade your Spirit Ashes. And the boss here drops the Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes if you're looking for a spirit ash item that can use spells and attack long range.

links.text: Frenzied Flame Village Outskirts site of grace

title: Investigate Ainsel River (Underground)
text: Ainsel River Well Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

To reach the underground section, you'll need to ride the lift from the Ainsel River Well that will take you down. ( Elden Ring Map Link). Beware tho that there is a single Golem enemy that is guarding this location. Once the Golem has been defeated simply walk through the entrance of the building to find a lever on the right wall and the elevator in the center of the building. Stepping on the button in the middle of the elevator will lower you down into the Ainsel River underground region.

From the Ainsel River Well Depths Site of Grace, you will see multiple Giant Ants clinging to the wall. Ignore them for a second and go right to pick up x3 Magic Grease. Now face the Ants. You can lure them down by approaching slowly, but you probably won't be able to fight them one by one. Try attacking them from range to achieve that. Go into the tunnel and pick up x8 Grace Mimic.

There is a single ant waiting to the right just past the item to ambush you. Head into the left corridor to find Smithing Stone (3). Along the way, more ants will be crawling out of the ground, or sneak up on you from behind. There is a total of at least 4 ants here, which can be fought individually. Head back to the main path, and this time, two Ants will drop down from above. There is an open cave ahead containing minor items and another Smithing Stone (3), guarded by an Ant in the far left corner.

Go right to find another room with Ghost Glovewort (1), x10 Shattershard Arrow (Fletched), and yet another Smithing Stone (3). Go up the stairs and cross the bridge to find the Ainsel River Sluice Gate Site of Grace. Go back and this time take the left path past the Smithing Stone, jumping up on the two stone ledges. You will enter a room with many ants on the ceiling and a bloated one in the center. It drops a Golden Rune (10) and a Rune Arc. Go straight ahead until you reach the Uhl Palace Ruins.

links.text: Ainsel River Well Depths Site of Grace
Ainsel River Sluice Gate Site of Grace

title: Elden Ring Walkthrough - Uhl Palace Ruins
text: To the right, you can see the elevator that is next to the previous site of grace. Walk across the stone arcs and loot a Smithing Stone (4), then jump down to the left for a Celestial Dew. Ideally, take out the Clayman from above, or try Guerilla tactics; they are fairly slow. Pick up some tier 1 upgrade materials on the ground, as well as small Golden Runes and Formic Rock. Go to the right past a statue and follow the river. you will see more ruins and more Clayman. Be careful and take cover since a Malformed Star will start shooting at you. Duck behind the various pillars, picking up a Ghost Glovewort (1) and Smithing Stone (1) x3 from a corpse on the ledge.

You can also leave these for now and come back after you have taken out the Malformed Star. Make your way across the pillars to the ruins on the left, then follow the path up to the Malformed Star. After defeating it, drop down to the left (facing the "tower"), the fall is lethal otherwise. Make your way inside the ruin to find the Nomadic Merchant ( Elden Ring Map Link) who sells some cookbooks, Lost Ashes of War, and another Celestial Dew. Pick up the Map from a corpse on the right. Go back out and to the right to pick up x3 Smithing Stone (3) and drop down to find the Ainsel River Downstream Site of Grace.

Now clean up the loot in the area, there should be two Golden Rune (3) and Ghost Glovewort (1) and (2) on the far side and along the river, a Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Throwing Dart, Magic Grease x2, and another Golden Rune (3) on the central stairs. Up the stairs and to the right there is Shield Grease in a corner.

Head back to the site of grace and further downstream the river to find another room with multiple Ants. On the left, you can find the Immunizing Horn Charm ( Elden Ring Map Link), x5 Crystal Dart, and x3 Smithing Stone (2). Continue this way and be ready for two Basilisks to the left, two more up ahead, and another one to the right further down the tunnel. The last one guards x4 Soap.

Go to the end for a nice view of the Lake of Rot. You can also pick up some Aeonian Butterflies and a Somber Smithing Stone (3) here. Head back into the Ant cave and pick up Ghost Glovewort (1) and Ghost Glovewort (2). If there are Ants remaining here, make your way past them, then head left to pick up Melted Mushroom x3. Turn the other way and pick up another Ghost Glovewort (2), then get ready to face the boss, Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella, by entering the tunnel to the left. Defeating the boss rewards you with Frozen Lightning Spear and 12,000 Runes in hand - don't forget to check the chest inside a room underneath the massive skeleton and throne to find the Great Ghost Glovewort - for now, there's nothing else that can be done in this zone right now so we'll head back up to Liurnia of the Lakes and explore its western shores.

title: Elden Ring Walkthrough - Liurnia of the Lakes: West
text: Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Liurnia of the Lakes (West) Points of Interest
Clear out the Village of the Albinaurics
Complete other Locations
Visit The Four Belfries
Meet Smithing Master Iji
Complete Caria Manor
Meet Renna and her Allies
Complete Siofra River (Underground)

title: Folly on the Lake - Site of Grace
text: If you were following our walkthrough, you've just returned from the underground map and completed some parts of it within Ainsel River. For this section, we will guide you to exploring the west section of Liurnia of the Lakes before we proceed onto the next region which is Caelid. We suggest that you start at the Folly on the Lake Site of Grace and work your way from the bottom to the top ( Elden Ring Map: Liurnia of the Lakes West Starting Point). Take note that it's entirely up to you on which location you want to complete first, you can always check the interactive Elden Ring Map to find what you need - now, your first stop, the Village of the Albinaurics.
Village of the Albinaurics Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

Along the way, you will pass by a swamp that is filled with poison, so we highly recommend that you travel to the village on mount. From the site, you can find the village on the southwest side of the map ( Elden Ring Map Link). As you travel by mount, simply move northwest and run alongside the cliff. Remain on the left side, pass through a swamp section, and just ignore the enemies you run into until you reach the distressed village. You'll know when you're near once you reach the swamp section and upon going up to a rise of the land - the name of the location will appear upon formally arriving at the village.

As you enter, move towards the house, check behind it to find the Village of the Albinauirics Site. Map Link. Discover and rest here before you start to explore. Now, clear this section first around the house where you'll encounter Albinauric enemies. Make sure to also loot the body near a stone coffin to obtain x1 Larval Tear, and grab the materials around to find Mushroom and Rowa Fruit. Next, turn around and heap up the hill where you'll encounter a single Perfumer enemy, killing it may drop x5 Budding Cave Moss. If you walk forward, passing the two houses, on the right side, you'll see a disguised NPC. This turns out to be Albus, who will give you an important key item for your journey. Hit the pot to reveal himself.

Before exhausting his dialogue, he will give you a key item, the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right). Speak to him again, exhaust his lines, and he will eventually die due to old age. Before you continue towards the boss, make sure to check behind the stone coffin next to Albus, there's another corpse that you can pillage to acquire an Ivory Sickle. If you don't need to rest at the site, you can proceed to the boss by crossing the stone bridge on this hill.

As you cross, you'll see a golden teardrop scarab. Make sure to kill it before it disappears. On the other side, you'll see a willow tree and a bonfire. The Omenkiller boss is there, as well as a few Rotten Stray. We suggest that you kill the hounds first so that you can fight the boss one on one. Instead of going down the slope, straight to the bonfire, jump down from the right side of the cliff and kill the Rotten Stray. Once the area is clear, then you can approach the bonfire and fight the Omenkiller.

You can visit the Omenkiller page to find more information about this boss, as well as guides and strategies on how to defeat this enemy. Successfully killing this boss yields 4900 Runes and drops the Crucible Knot Talisman. Make sure to also check the right side of this small arena and you will another body at the end of the path, pillage it to find x1 Rune Arc.

Before you leave this location, there is just one more section you need to clear. Return to the site of the village, next to the house near it, you'll find a wooden bridge. Cross the wooden bridge, kill the Albinauric enemies and make sure to loot the bodies here to find some items, as well as gathering some Erdleaf Flower. One can be found resting by the tree trunk, loot it to acquire x1 Albinauric Bloodclot, while the other is near a ledge, pillage that body to find a Crystal Sword. Also, if you check under the bridge leading from the swamp up to the village, you can find Nepheli Loux, she will return to the Roundtable Hold after you kill the Omenkiller - if you kill her, she will drop x2 of the Stormhawk Axe weapon.

There are some locations near the Village of the Albinaurics that you can also visit before you continue exploring the northwest side of the Liurnia Map, but some can only be accessed if you've made significant progress to Ranni's questline:

Chelona's Rise ( Elden Ring Map Link): A tower found in the very corner of the upper plateau in Liurnia's southwest. This tower is initially sealed, with an imp statue at the entrance holding a glowing book, instructing you to "seek three great wise beasts". See the tower's page for details. You can find the sorcery spell, Ranni's Dark Moon in a chest at the top of this tower. Nearby is the Altar South Site of Grace as well.
Moonfolk Ruins ( Elden Ring Map Link): A ruins section where you can gather some materials and find x1 Somber Smithing Stone [8].

Lunar Estate Ruins ( Elden Ring Map Link): The ruins of a large estate found in the southern plateau of Liurnia, accessible only after making significant progress in Ranni's questline. Once accessible, you can find a Golden Rune [8] in this ruins location.

Cathedral of Manus Celes ( Elden Ring Map Link): Located at South West Liurnia of The Lakes. Accessible only after making significant progress in Ranni's questline. You can find the Glintstone Dragon Adula roaming around only if you've dealt enough damage to it at its initial location in Three Sisters.

links.text: Elden Ring Map: Liurnia of the Lakes West Starting Point

title: Seek the Converted Tower
text: Converted Tower Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

Return to the Folly on the Lake Site and this time, head west, before you reach the tower, you should find a Teardrop Scarab near the edge of the cliffs that drop a Somber Smithing Stone [2] ( Elden Ring Map Link). You should find the entrance of the Converted Tower, use the Erudition Gesture in front of the statue for the ladder to appear. Climb to the top to find a Memory Stone. The Erudition Gesture is obtained by giving Thops the second Academy Glintstone Key at the Church of Irith. Alternatively, if you don't have the Erudition gesture unlocked yet and you're skilled enough on horseback, the puzzle can be skipped by using Torrent to climb the wall surrounding the tower. Then just jump up on the balcony in the back and jump off Torrent - also don't forget to discover the site of grace of this tower.

title: Minor Erdtree & Road's End Catacombs
text: Follow the road going north from the Converted Tower and you should find the Minor Erdtree for the southwest section of Liurnia ( Elden Ring Map Link). This section is guarded by an Erdtree Avatar and if you defeat it, you'll be able to acquire the Cerulean Crystal Tear and the Ruptured Crystal Tear.

Also, situated in between the Minor Erdtree and the Converted Tower, on the west side of the map, the Road's End Catacombs location can be found ( Elden Ring Map Link). Road's End Catacombs is a pretty straightforward dungeon, with just some slight changes to it. As you open the doors of the catacombs, head down the stairs and you will find the site of grace for the Road's End Catacombs. Make sure to discover it and rest if needed before exploring.
Road's End Catacombs Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

Just like the previous catacombs, this section is inhabited by Imps that love to hide around corners, on ceilings, walls, and are ready to ambush you.
