Head down the stairs and you will encounter the first Imp, grab x1 Grave Violet, and as you move towards the arched doorway, there is another Imp ready to ambush you on the right side corner. Get ready to dodge or put your shield up as soon as you approach the doorway. Before going down, make sure to pull the lever next to the reaper statue.

By the bush, you can gather some upgrade materials such as Grave Glovewort [2], continue going down, go straight, and you'll notice a dead end on the left. Look up, you'll find another Imp on the ceiling. Shoot it down, kill it and grab another Grave Glovewort [2] material. Be careful not to step on the pedestal that triggers arrows to shoot you. Grab the Grave Glovewort [2] on the right and another Grave Glovewort [3] ahead. Now you may think that there's nothing left to explore. But if you hit the wall of the dead-end where the Grave Glovewort [3] was, you'll reveal the illusory wall.

Beyond that path are more Imps inside a room that has an altar. Kill all the enemies and open the chest to find the Raya Lucaria Soldier Ashes. Now, go back to that spot where you grabbed a few glovewort materials by the bush, there is another illusory wall next to the stairs that go back up. Kill the imp and grab some items here such as another Ghost Glovewort [2] and a Rune Arc. The path ahead is dark so equip a Torch if you're having a hard time seeing. Past the body that you just looted, move forward a bit and turn left, enter the narrow path and you'll find another body at a dead-end. Loot it to find x3 Root Resin.

Now, hit the wall in front of the body you just looted to reveal yet another illusory wall. Go down, grab another Grave Glovewort [2], and hit the illusory wall ahead to reveal another section behind it. You'll find the path that leads to the mini-boss of this location, the Spirit-Caller Snail. You can visit our Spirit-Caller Snail to find guides on how to defeat this boss - successfully defeating it drops the Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes and 3000 Runes.

title: Revenger's Shack - Edgar, the Revenger
text: Revenger's Shack Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

Just north from the Minor Erdtree, you'll find the Revenger's Shack ( Elden Ring Map Link), if you followed the father-daughter questline of Irina and Edgar, resting at the shack's site will trigger a hostile NPC invader to appear, and this is Edgar the Revenger. Killing him drops the following: 316 Runes, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Shabriri Grape, Banished Knight's Halberd (+8), and x5 Raw Meat Dumpling.

title: Cuckoo's Evergaol
text: Continue moving north from the shack and you will find the Cuckoo's Evergaol ( Elden Ring Map Link). Cuckoo's Evergaol is located along Liurnia's western landmass, easily accessed on foot or horseback. This Evergaol does not require a Stonesword Key to unlock. The portal mechanism in the center is active as soon as you enter the area. Enter the portal to challenge the boss within, Bols, Carian Knight.
Cuckoo's Evergaol Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

Bols is a Troll Knight clad in Carian armor, wielding a massive greatsword. Due to his size, his movements are rather slow and his attacks have a hefty weight behind them. He compensates for this by frequently roaring, which not only increases his damage but releases a burst of pressure that staggers players. Be careful as he tends to combo into his attacks after a roar. Bols is tall enough that you can easily and safely dodge under his legs to avoid most of his attacks, but never take your eyes off him as he can quickly turn around for a devastating follow-up - successfully defeating this mini-boss drops the Greatblade Phalanx spell.

title: The Four Belfries
text: The Four Belfries Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

Continuing north from Cuckoo's Evergaol is The Four Belfries ( Elden Ring Map Link) The Four Belfries is a hub for transporter waygates that lead to various locations. Each waygate requires an Imbued Sword Key to activate and is located at the foot of a belfry.

The First Belfry: The first waygate is located closest to the foot of the hill. This transports you to a small sub-area of the Crumbling Farum Azula containing the Pearldrake Talisman. You cannot access the rest of the region from this sub-area. [ Elden Ring Map Link]

The Second Belfry: The second waygate is located further up the hill and to the east. This transports you to the Chapel of Anticipation, where you began the game. You can fight the first boss here which is the Grafted Scion. [ Elden Ring Map Link]

The Third Belfry: The third waygate is located to the west of the second one. This transports you to an otherwise inaccessible location in Nokron, Eternal City, housing the Mottled Necklace and a Lesser Crucible Knight. [ Elden Ring Map Link]

The Fourth Belfry: The final belfry is located at the peak of the hill. This belfry does not contain a waygate but instead houses a chest with an Imbued Sword Key in it. You can use this to open up any of the waygates of your choosing.

Other than that, make sure to activate the site of grace for this location. Once you're back or if you continue traveling, take the lower road north and loot the Hearse for the Carian Knight's Sword ( Elden Ring Map Link). And further ahead of the Northern Liurnia Lake Shore Site, you can find the map fragment for Map (Liurnia, West) by the monolith ( Elden Ring Map Link).

title: Kingsrealm Ruins
text: Kingsrealm Ruins Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

Just about northeast from where you got the map, you'll find the Kingsrealm Ruins ( Elden Ring Map Link), this ruins location hosts a hidden, underground area where the optional boss Royal Revenant can be fought The stairs leading down into this area is covered by an illusory floor. You can find this in the northeast section of the ruins. The floor needs to be rolled on to dispel the illusion or hit with a melee weapon to be revealed. You can visit our Royal Revenant page to find our video guide, as well as a written strategy on how to defeat this mini-boss - successfully defeating the Royal Revenant rewards the player with 3,100 Runes, you'll also gain access to the room that holds a chest containing the Frozen Needle weapon.

title: Meet Smithing Master Iji
text: From the Kingsrealm Ruins, continue moving north and you can find Smithing Master Iji ( Elden Ring Map Link). This blacksmith sells Upgrade Materials such as Somber Smithing Stone [1] through [4]. This blacksmith is a gentle giant in charge of the smithing for the Carian royals, but will also provide his services to players. Make sure to talk to him when you see him. Your next step is to head to the Caria Manor, but we'll just note down some things for you:

Acquire the Intelligence-knot Crystal Tear ( Elden Ring Map Link): From Road to the Manor Site of Grace, head southeast down the slope and turn back towards the north. Loot from a small, half-bowl structure guarded by a few Lesser Spider Hand and one Spider Hand enemies.

Seluvis's Rise (Elden Ring Map Link): One of three towers found in the Three Sisters sub-region. Three Sisters is accessible after completing Caria Manor and defeating Royal Knight Loretta. So return here when you're done with Caria Manor.

title: Complete Caria Manor of Liurnia
text: Caria Manor Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

Caria Manor is a major dungeon comprised of a very large estate, overlooking the lakes from the north. Its eternal warden, Royal Knight Loretta fervently guards the manor. The large estate can be found in Liurnia of the Lakes, far to the north ( Elden Ring Map Link). We will include a quick run-through of the paths to take to get to the boss of this location, as well as important landmarks. You can, however, visit the Caria Manor page for a more in-depth guide such as a list of items found in this location and more.

Caria Manor is accessed from its main gate in the south. Before the constant bombardment of glintstone arrows as you approach the gate. The estate's guardian is constantly bombarding the fields outside the manor to deter would-be trespassers. Once you reach the Site of Grace at the main gate, you are safe from these bombardments. When traversing the estate grounds, watch out for Glintstone traps. These are swords buried in the ground which spring a projectile trap that shoots a glintstone projectile upwards when walked on. These traps knock players away which is especially dangerous when on the higher levels of the estate.

The southernmost area of the estate is the Gardens. This is a very large courtyard infested with Spider Hands and their smaller counterparts. Be very careful when walking around the gardens as these Spider Hand enemies can cling to the walls of buildings, dropping down onto unsuspecting targets. They can also burrow into the ground and emerge only when prey is nearby.

The Chapel building is an important landmark found in the west of the Gardens. The upper level contains a Site of Grace and leads to the walkways in the gardens that will allow you to reach many different collectibles as well as progress to the manor's upper level. These walkways are guarded by Knight Spirits who appear as you move around the walkways. Be extra careful of glintstone traps up here as they can knock you back down to the gardens. Follow the walkways towards the east to reach a tower with a lift that will take you up to the Manor Upper Level.

The Manor Upper Level comprises the northern half of the estate. This area is raised high above the gardens and is guarded by Direwolves and Wandering Noble zombies. Past the Direwolves, you will find a large stone archway to the east. Beyond this is a long staircase leading up to the final area and boss. However, it is heavily guarded by Raya Lucarian soldiers and a Troll Knight. If you look to the south, there is a platform with a ladder that you can climb up which will allow you to circumvent all the enemies at the large staircase as you will wind up behind the troll. Consider using this path if you are rushing through or don't want to face a large group of hostiles. Behind the troll are more staircases to the left and right, each with a Page enemy.

At the very top of the staircases, you can look to the south to find a hole in the wall. This leads to an area outside with wooden platforms along the walls which you can jump down from to reach the cliffside graveyards. There are some collectibles to be found along these cliffs and they are guarded by Living Jar enemies.

Back at the staircase, continue on through the stone archway to find a large circular arena-like area surrounded by chairs. Once you step into the center of this area, Royal Knight Loretta will appear before you. She is the guardian of this manor and also the one bombarding the fields outside with arrows. She uses a combination of glintstone sorcery spells and polearm attacks in combat. Defeating her awards the Loretta's Greatbow sorcery spell as well as the Ash of War: Loretta's Slash - defeating Loretta will spawn a Site of Grace in her arena and allow you access to the back of the manor.

title: Meeting Renna and her Allies
text: Ranni's Rise Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

Upon completing Caria Manor, your next destination will be Ranni's Rise ( Elden Ring Map Link) but be wary since you may come across the Glintstone Dragon Adula, you don't have to fight this dragon, it's optional, and up to you. At Ranni's Rise, go all the way to the top and talk to Ranni the Witch to begin her questline: The Hidden Treasure of Nokron. Take her request and she will ask you to talk to three people who are in her service, these Are Seluvis, War Counselor Iji, and Blaidd who will appear in spectral form. These three will then appear in a spectral form on the first floor of her tower - talk to Ranni again after speaking to everyone to leave.

Now, moving forward, we will guide you to complete this quest. Blaidd will be waiting in the Siofra River area and will reveal that he suspects that Seluvis knows more than he lets on. Seluvis will inform you that Sorceress Sellen has some information, and provide you with Seluvis's Introduction. Sorceress Sellen then informs the player that Starscourge Radahn stopped the stars and that defeating him is the key to Nokron's secrets.

Therefore the first step is to visit Siofra and complete it. BE WARNED: if you follow Preceptor Seluvis's questline, you will betray Ranni and fail her quest. We will not do this on this walkthrough but you can read about it on his page: Preceptor Seluvis.

title: Explore Siofra River (Underground)
text: Siofra River Well Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

For this location, we highly recommend checking our interactive Elden Ring Map to check the items that can be found, as well as points of interest for the underground section. Elden Ring Map: Siofra River Starting Point. Head to Mistwood, go down Siofra River Well and make sure to discover the Site of Grace here if you haven't. The underground section is guarded by Ancestral Follower enemies and it is recommended that you take them out or try to take the advantage of dealing enough damage at a distance.

Some foraging for materials can be done here as well. One notable material you can acquire is a Golden Centipede which will be at the corner on some rubble when you approach the large statue. It is quite bright in color and hard to miss. Other materials can be forged around the grass and will have a glow for you to recognize them. Siofra River Well is also abundant in Dewkissed Herba.

On the upper levels, there will be a corpse draped over a wall gap. Loot it to gain Budding Horn x3. If you look at the stone wall of the ruins on the upper level, you'll notice they form stepping blocks that you can traverse the top of the walls. Carefully traverse the walls to get another Golden Centipede, and other items. You will also find two Ancestral Followers in front of a hole on the ground, after grabbing everything you can on the upper section, carefully drop into the hole to find a Teardrop Scarab that will drop the Oracle Bubbles, next to the scarab is a lootable corpse.

Continue onwards till you reach a large flight of stairs next to a waterfall. There will be another body draped over the handrail where you can obtain Golden Rune (4). Directly in the waterfall, you can also obtain Soap.

You can take the next lift to the next section, exit the lift at the top, turn north and run across the bridge walkway. Enter the structure, there will be a body containing Preserving Boluses. Under the bridge area, you can walk into the river, and on one of the bridge arches, you will find Beast Liver x3. Be careful progressing from here as you may encounter a Giant Crab, but nearby you should also be able to loot some Crab Eggs.

As you move forward you will run into an Obelisk where you can light the flame. If you head up on the rocks behind there will be an Ancestral Follower. Nearby, you can loot some remains to obtain Armorer's Cookbook (6) - the last large staircase lined with obelisks will lead to Hallowhorn Grounds.

Now, this area has a mechanic to summon a special boss: you must light altars scattered around the zone. There's a map of their location on the Siofra River page. You will find Blaidd standing near hallowhorn grounds, you can talk to him to advance his quest. You should then proceed to locate and activate the pillars in the area:
First Pillar is by the site of grace Siofra River Bank. ( Elden Ring Map Link)
Second Pillar is in a corner west of the first pillar. ( Elden Ring Map Link)
Third Pillar is on a small island in a watery area with lightning whisps. ( Elden Ring Map Link)
Fourth Pillar is by a cliff on the eastern area of the map. ( Elden Ring Map Link)
Fifth Pillar is just south of Worshipper's Woods site of grace. ( Elden Ring Map Link)
Sixth Pillar is west of Worshipper's Woods site of grace. ( Elden Ring Map Link)
Seventh Pillar is to the right on the path toward "Below the Well" site of grace. ( Elden Ring Map Link)
Eight Pillar is on the left on the path toward "Below the Well" site of grace. ( Elden Ring Map Link)

When all pillars are lit, you can now enter the arena of the Ancestor Spirit boss. The deer carcass at the back of the temple starts glowing and you can interact with it to teleport to the boss' area. You won't be thrown into battle as soon as you teleport, however, and will have to walk through a mist door to fight the boss. Make sure to visit our Ancestor Spirit page to find our different strategies and also a video guide on how to beat this boss - by defeating it, players are rewarded with 13000 Runes and the Ancestral Follower Ashes.

You can exit the area by interacting with a white teleporter in the middle of the arena you fought the boss in. It might be hard to spot due to the size of the arena, but won't miss it if you start with your back to the boss door and proceed forward. As you explore, you can also take a gateway ( see on map) to access the Dragonkin Soldier boss fight. This Great Enemy drops the Dragon Halberd, and players can loot the Marika's Scarseal talisman from nearby. Dropping down from here and going north will also bring you to a Golden Seed and the "Below the Well" site of grace.

links.text: Elden Ring Map: Siofra River Starting Point

title: Elden Ring Walkthrough - Caelid
text: Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Caelid (South) Points of Interest
Defeat the NPC Invader at Smoldering Church.
Clear out Fort Gael.
Complete Sellia Crystal Tunnels.
Travel to Sellia, Town of Sorcery.
Participate in the Festival at Redmane Castle.

title: The Smoldering Church
text: Smoldering Church Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

To begin the walkthrough for Caelid, let us start at the Smoldering Church, located northeast of Stormhill ( Elden Ring Map Link). You'll notice that there are multiple bloodstains around the entrance of the church, this is because an NPC Invader, Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater, will appear here when you walk up to the entrance of the church. This NPC invader wields a curved greatsword and her moves can easily be read. Make sure to dodge when she does that leaping attack and you can follow up with your attacks before she recovers as soon as she hits the ground or if she uses an attack where she swings her weapon while she walks forward, use this opportunity to hit her with ranged attacks. Defeating this NPC invader drops the Sacred Scorpion Charm and a Furlcalling Finger Remedy - make sure to check inside the church to find the site of grace and two bodies holding the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [14] and the Missionary's Cookbook [3].

title: Elden Ring Walkthrough - Gael Tunnel
text: Gael Tunnel Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

Now, if you want to gather some Smithing Stones and Somber Smithing Stones, you can check Gael Tunnel, southeast from the Smoldering Church ( Elden Ring Map Link). You can also find Iron Fist Alexander inside the cave. The Site of Grace for this dungeon is found in a very deep pit ahead of the entrance past two Soldiers. There is no lift to take you down so you will need to do some platforming along the edges of the pit. There is a small room next to the second ledge you drop down to on the left. There is a corpse here with a Somber Smithing Stone (2). From the Site of Grace, head north through the tunnel archway to a large cavern with wooden walkways. Kill the Soldier on the right then head down the steps and clear the Miners and Soldiers on this floor. There is a corpse on the left with a Golden Rune (5).

Head down the steps for more Miners and Soldiers congregating by the fire and a few more under the walkway. There is a Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot behind some crates in the very back below the walkway. Look to the east for a tunnel leading to another cavern crawling with Land Octopi and a single Giant Land Octopus hanging from the ceiling in the back. There is a corpse below where the giant octopus was hanging from that contains a Cross-Naginata weapon.

Head back into the main cavern and go west to find a soldier kneeling by a ladder. Take him out and then descend the ladder to find another Soldier and a Miner. Loot the corpse in the center for 5x Large Glintstone Scrap and the other corpse nearby for a Grace Mimic. Continue along to the tunnel in the south to a room with a large wooden gate to the right which contains the boss arena, as well as a smaller wooden door straight ahead. Go through the small door first which leads to the rear entrance of the tunnel as well as the second Site of Grace which you should activate. Head back to the large gate to challenge the boss of this dungeon.

This boss is highly susceptible to magic damage. Use sorcery spells that hit multiple times such as Glintblade Phalanx or Greatblade Phalanx to quickly break its poise and get a critical hit in. Sorcery mains can very easily lock this boss down. If you aren't sorcery focused, however, you will need to watch out for its mad dash attack where it spews lava from its mouth and then dashes around the room, leaving lava trails along the ground that persist for a few seconds. It is also equipped with a very large curved greatsword which it uses to slash in very wide arcs. However, its sword attacks are very slow with a very long wind-up. Take advantage of these animations and get hits in when you can - upon defeat, the Magma Wyrm drops a Dragon Heart, the Moonveil katana, as well as 7,500 Runes.

title: Minor Erdtree - Caelid
text: Minor Erdtree (Caelid) Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

Next, travel north from Gael Tunnel and you should find the Minor Erdtree of Caelid ( Elden Ring Map Link). This area is protected by a field boss, the Erdtree Avatar, and defeating it drops the Greenburst Crystal Tear and the Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear items for your flask. You can also find a Cracked Pot here; one can be found at the end of a tree branch extending from the northwest cliffs behind the tree.

Since you're already here, you might as well explore the Minor Erdtree Catacombs that are nearby, so that you can gather some upgrade materials for your Spirit Ashes, and you can also acquire a new Spirit Ash. Imps make these catacombs their home, with many of them perched on the walls and the ceilings, awaiting passersby. Bring ranged attacks and spells or craft throwable Consumables to knock them off their perches and prevent unwanted surprises Press the target lock key frequently to easily find these mischievous creatures.

From the site of grace, head down the first corridor ahead and hit the Imp on the ceiling from afar. There is a lift leading down around the corner. From the lift, head down the western corridor and defeat the Imp in the corner. The room around the corner has a couple more Imps inside. There is a Grave Violet just before you enter the room and a Grave Glovewort (5) at the back of the room before the next room. In the next room, there is an imp hiding on the right side and one more clinging to the ceiling. After defeating them, pull the lever by the statue and then head back to the lift.

This time, head towards the east corridor and collect the Grave Glovewort (4) on the way. In the next room, hit one of the Imps in the upper level from the corridor and three Skeletal Slimes will drop in from the ceiling. There are several more slimes in the room behind the pillars and a couple more Imps in the upper level. Beware of the floor here which is oozing with water that inflicts rot. There is a Grave Glovewort (3) to the right by the entrance and an Aeonian Butterfly on the corpse in the center. There is another Grave Violet and a Grave Glovewort (5) in the back half of the room.

Head back to the lift once more and step on the switch then get off before it rises. The rest of the dungeon is found in a passageway underneath the lift. Drop below and take out the Imp patrolling the area. The next room is filled with the same scarlet rot fluid and several slimes will drop down from the ceiling as you approach. You can take them out or just sprint past them. There is a narrow passage to the north with a set of stairs leading to a room with a bunch of crabs. Take them out and pick up the Grave Glovewort (4) and Golden Rune (4) by the wall at the end. On the east side of this room is a ladder leading up to a long hallway. Take the Imp out and pick up the Grave Glovewort (3) on the way.

There is another Imp on the ceiling halfway through the hallway and one more in the room at the very end. Pick up the Imp Head (Wolf) helm from the corpse bent over the sarcophagus and then turn right toward another room. This is the upper level of the first room with the scarlet rot fluid. Take the Imps out on the balcony if you haven't done so earlier. Check the corpse ahead for 2 x Sacramental Buds and head to the left for another Grave Glovewort (5). From here, you can head back to the second scarlet rot fluid-drenched room and continue to the western corridor and turn left to find the dungeon's boss door.

This boss fight is a Duo battle against two Erdtree Burial Watchdogs. One has a Sword, similar to the one encountered in Stormfoot Catacombs while the other has a Scepter. It is recommended you focus on the scepter one as it uses ranged magical projectiles. Consider summoning a spirit to distract one dog while you focus on the other. Aside from that, the strategies are largely the same as previous encounters. Always be on the move. If you are running, their aerial slam attacks should not hit you. Weave in 1 or 2 attacks max between slams and other weapon attacks. Watch out for when a Watchdog stands on its hind legs. It will slowly walk towards you and slam its weapon down very quickly. Be ready to dodge sideways - defeating the duo awards the Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes - now your next location is to clear Fort Gael but there are a few locations you may want to check out since you will encounter them anyway.

Isolated Merchant's Shack ( Elden Ring Map Link): Located East of the Minor Erdtree, there is a merchant here and a site of grace. Resting at nightfall and entering the shack triggers a mini field boss to appear, the Bell Bearing Hunter. Defeating it drops the Gravity Stone Peddler's Bell Bearing. Behind the shack is a Teardrop Scarab as well that drops the Ash of War: Sky Shot upon killing it.
Shack of Rotting ( Elden Ring Map Link): You can find a site of grace here to discover and activate. There are also some materials here and Preserving Boluses that you can loot.

Forsaken Ruins ( Elden Ring Map Link): The area is guarded by two Giant Crows. But you can gather some materials here such as Faded Erdleaf Flower, Trina's Lily, Golden Rune [5], and Smithing Stone [4]. Make sure to also have a Stonesword Key in your inventory so that you can dispel the fog leading to the cellar. The cellar has a chest containing the Sword of St. Trina.

Caelem Ruins ( Elden Ring Map Link): Ruins found on the western portion of Caelid, where the Caelid Highway cuts through. These ruins are filled with burning Putrid Corpses that shamble towards targets and explode kamikaze-style. There are also several Maneuverable Flamethrowers roaming the ruins. The cellar area is guarded by two Mad Pumpkin Head. Defeating these two awards 6,300 Runes and allows access to the treasure room at the back, where you can find a chest containing the Visage Shield.

Abandoned Cave ( Elden Ring Map Link): East of Smoldering Wall Grace on the eastern wall of the canyon, and slightly northwest of the Sellia Evergaol. The location is only reachable by approaching from the west and crossing the canyon using a tree. You can find items here such as the Serpent Bow. the Venomous Fang, and upon defeating the Cleanrot Knights, you can acquire the Golden Scarab talisman and 7000 Runes.

title: Clear out Fort Gael
text: Fort Gael Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

Follow the guide in the Fort Gael page for up-to-date info. At the end of Fort Gael, still take the waygate teleporter at the top of the watchtower, then head west across the bridge to activate the Impassable Greatbridge shrine, as this will prevent the need of traveling through Fort Gael again when ready to go to Redmane Castle.

title: Sellia Crystal Tunnel
text: Sellia Crystal Tunnel Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

There are a lot of items that you can find in the open world, so we highly suggest that you visit our Interactive Elden Ring Map to find the items that you want to find or at least discover the ones you've missed. The next location after Fort Gael will be Sellia Crystal Tunnel, northeast from the Abandoned Cave ( Elden Ring Map Link). Just like any other tunnel location, this is a good area to gather Smithing Stones and Somber Smithing Stones. There is an alternate way as well to enter, you can reach this location (and by extension Caelid) early by opening the chest in Dragon-Burnt Ruins. It will envelop you in smoke and transport you to the mine but be warned, the enemies within may be too difficult for you at this time.

This section assumes you reached the dungeon naturally by exploring Caelid. From the Site of Grace, head north and up the ladder to reach a large cavern with many Digger enemies mining for crystals. These enemies are weak against magic and piercing attacks but resistant against other attack types. You can ascend by heading up the slope on the right but be careful of the Prawn Miners along the way. There is one standing atop the storage shed on the left. When you reach the top of the path, head for the end of the wooden walkway on the left and kill the prawn on the way. At the end of the walkway is a corpse with a Rune Arc. Opposite the walkway, you can find a Somber Smithing Stone (5) on the wall behind some creates. Head back to the storage shed with the Prawn that you passed on the way and jump up on its roof to reach the wooden platform in the east and drop down the edge of this platform to proceed.

In the tunnels ahead, beware of an ambush by a Digger and pick up the Smithing Stone (5) on the ground on the left. In the next section, climb up the ladder and go around the wooden walkway to find a corpse with a Somber Smithing Stone (4). Head north and take out the Prawn above the storage shed ahead. A Digger will also come out the side towards you. Check the shed for a chest containing the Rock Blaster spell. Go around the shed and take the ladder to the roof. There is a Golden Rune (4) on a corpse by the ladder. Kill the Diggers on the roof and head west to spot a tunnel. There is a Somber Smithing Stone (4) before the entrance to the right.

When you enter the next section, be careful of an ambush by a Prawn in the wooden structure to the left. There's a corpse with a Dragonwound Grease in front of the room and a Somber Smithing Stone (4) inside the room. There are two more Prawns on the elevated platform to the northeast. Take them out and collect the Faithful's Canvas Talisman on the corpse by the wall and the Smithing Stone (5) to the left. Head back down the raised platform and through the tunnel to the southwest and through the large wooden gate to engage this dungeon's boss.

The Fallingstar Beast is a massive quadruped made up of crystals or rock. It has a long spiky tail and a head reminiscent of a centipede's, with massive mandibles extending from its face. Because of the boss' size, you will have little room for maneuvering. The main attacks to watch out for are its head swipe combo, in which it bashes its head from side-to-side multiple times as well as its charge attack, in which it dashes towards you three times, quickly changing directions after each charge.

The beast can also cause the ground to erupt in a rockburst. This is telegraphed by lightning forming on its mandibles, as well as on the ground, indicating where the ground will burst. The key to defeating this boss is to constantly be on the move and attack during its long recovery animations. Defeating the Fallingstar Beast rewards you with the Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing (1), x4 Gravity Stone Chunk, a Somber Smithing Stone (6) and x5 Smithing Stone (7), as well as 7,600 Runes - for more information of this boss, you can visit our Fallingstar Beast page.
Your next destination is Sellia, Town of Sorcery, but the following can be done/obtained on the way:

Slightly southeast of the Astray from Caelid Highway North grace site, you will find the Aeonia Swamp Shore grace site. Then north of that you will find the Street of Sages Ruins, go there to find some items.
Go south of the Astray from Caelid Highway North grace site, and you'll find the Caelid Highway South grace site, head east along the road and you'll find the Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank grace site.
South of the Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank grace site, you can find a Windy Crystal Tear for your physick flask.
Continuing south, you can find a Golden Seed.
Following the road further south, then go west when the road splits, you can find a Teardrop Scarab that will drop a Somber Smithing Stone [3].
Continue west from there and you will find the entrance to Caelid Catacombs.

title: Travel to Sellia, Town of Sorcery
text: To the east of the Swamp is Sellia, Town of Sorcery. This is an important location with many items to pick up. Notably, you will meet Gowry at his shack just north of Sellia Gateway, who will task you with defeating Commander O'Neil in the swamp to obtain the Unalloyed Gold Needle. Return it to him, and then head further northeast to the Church of the Plague to meet Millicent. Follow the steps outlined in her questline to obtain Prosthesis-Wearer Heirloom and then exhaust her dialogue to move her to Altus Plateau. Make sure to loot the Sacred Tear in the area, then head into Sellia proper.

From the Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank grace site, make your way north past Sellia Gateway. Note that along the way, there will be a troll atop a high cliff to the east that will throw projectiles at you, keep moving until you past the gate to avoid getting hit.

Beyond the gate, you should see a shack on the east side of the road, but along the path to the shack, there's a docile Giant Dog sitting there watching the roads. Don't disturb it and go around it, unless you plan on killing it, because if you run towards the shack with it chasing you, there's a chance it may kill Gowry, a very important NPC in this questline.

Speak with Gowry in his shack and he will ask for a favor. He wants help to heal a young girl, Millicent, found beyond Sellia, who has the Scarlot Rot. To do this he will ask you to seek an Unalloyed Gold Needle dropped by Commander O'Neil located in the deep scarlet Swamp of Aeonia, outside Sellia's bounds. In return, he will share the secrets of the town of Sellia.
Teleport to the Aeonia Swamp Shore grace site, and head northeast towards the brambles in the swamp.

You may get invaded by Millicent along the way, so be careful and not fight her in the swamp, as you will be at a disadvantage due to the rot. Either find a safe ground and lure her in on safe grounds, or have some Preserving Boluses handy.
Be aware that there's a Cleanrot Knight that patrols the area and may attack you.
You can summon your Spirit Ash here as the fight is not instanced.
The ground around the boss can cause rot buildup, so be vigilant.
After beating the commander, make sure to discover the Heart of Aeonia grace site before continuing. Return to Gowry and give him the Unalloyed Gold Needle.
Warp to a nearby point or quit the game then reload and return and he'll give you the repaired needle.

Light the beacons in Sellia, according to the secret Gowry gave you, to open the way to the church. Three need to be lit and this will also unlock treasure chests behind each barrier with the final barrier allowing access to a double boss fight.

Follow the Sellia, Town of Sorcery walkthrough. After that, discover the Chair-Crypt of Sellia site of grace, then warp back to the Sellia Under-Stair grace site, run up the staircases, then head northeast, up the giant staircases where you got the Golden Seed, and go through the gate and discover the Sellia Backstreets grace site. From here, follow the road east then south to the Church of the Plague.

After Millicent uses the needle, rest at the nearby site of grace, then exhaust her dialog. She will gift you the Prosthesis-Wearer Heirloom. Rest again/ quit and reload at the site of grace to move her to Gowry's shack.
Return to Gowry's shack to find him gone, but Millicent is there. Exhaust her dialog. Quit/ reload at the shack, this will move Millicent and have Gowry return. You can now purchase spells from him.

Millicent now will be located just north of the Erdtree-Gazing Hill Grace in Altus Plateau [ Map Link]. The player can give her the Valkyrie's Prosthesis item to advance her questline after exhausting her dialogue.
The rest of the questline for Millicent is located in another region. To continue reading about Millicent's questline, please check or Millicent page.

title: The Radahn Festival in Redmane Castle
text: Redmane Castle Elden Ring Map. Click on the image above to enlarge it.

Redmane Castle is a small castle that is heavily guarded at the castle's outskirts by Radahn Knights and Soldiers. The Redmane Castle serves as the gathering point for warriors alike who are wanting to participate in the Radahn Festival. ( Elden Ring Map Link)

NOTE: (App ver. 1.02.3) Either collecting both Dectus Medallion halves and taking the Grand Lift of Dectus OR reaching far enough in Ranni's questline, Blaidd will siege the castle and kill almost every enemy and the duo boss. This will make going through the castle easier but doors will be locked leaving you temporarily out of some loot. After defeating Radahn, speak to Blaidd on the battlefield. Then fast travel to the Chamber Outside The Plaza Grace, speak to the Castellan at the chapel, and rest at the Grace several times. This repopulates the castle and unlocks the doors allowing access to previously unavailable loot including the Red-Hot Whetblade.**

Before you go forward make sure you to read up on Ranni the Witch's questline, and complete it up at least up to the point where you received an introduction from Preceptor Seluvis to Sorceress Sellen, take the introduction to the sorceress (at this point she should be at the Waypoint Ruins) and show it to her before continuing with the following below.

The fastest way to reach Redmane Castle is by using the waygate teleporter found on the watchtower of Fort Gael [ Map Coordinates]. When you arrive, you'll find yourself outside the fortified outskirts of the castle. If you haven't already, be sure to first head west across the bridge to activate the Impassable Greatbridge shrine. Next to the shrine, there is a watchtower you could climb to gain loot from. Be careful though as at the top of the first ladders, there are 2x Radahn Soldiers wielding spears and a Radahn Knight also wielding a spear at the top of the second ladder. Work your way back east across the bridge, and around the base of watchtower encountered here to find x1 Smithing Stone [3] on a corpse. Continue up the pathway until you encounter the main gate, which is currently closed. Follow around castle to the southwest until you see the same tower we previously went around to loot a smithing stone. Jumping the gap to its roof, you can then climb down two ladders in order to find a corpse that can then be pillaged to acquire x1 Smithing Stone [6]. Climb back up both ladders and jump off the tower towards the cliffs on the southeast to continue (you might want to summon Torrent to make this jump easier).

Along the path of the cliffs, you'll encounter Giant Bat enemies. Keep moving southeast as you reach the top and around the castle where you'll come across a field full of tombstones and a large tree without its leaves. You'll encounter a few enemies here such as more Giant Bats and a Poisonous Bat by the tree, but more importantly, a Teardrop Scarab, hiding between some tombstones on the left. Make sure to quickly kill the Teardrop Scarab to obtain x1 Ash of War: Flaming Strike - make sure to check behind the tree to find x1 Miquella's Lily and x8 Smoldering Butterfly that is looted off a corpse that is sitting against a tombstone.

From here, use the ladder to climb to the top, you don't need to take the stairs since the door at the top is locked and can only be opened from the other side. At the top of the ladder, make a left and simply follow the path of the rooftop section until you reach another ladder on the west that you'll need to climb down. At the bottom, you'll first encounter a Zombie Dog roaming. Kill it and enter the stable-like room on the left where you'll see multiple Commoner enemies resting (most of them will not attack you unless you do). Inside that room, you can loot two corpses to find Armorer's Cookbook [5] and x1 Smithing Stone [5]. Don't forget to unlock the door here to open the shortcut leading back to the open field with tombstones.

Go back outside, turn left and you'll see another arch doorway. Inside that room, there is a single Executioner-looking enemy that wields a crossbow. You can kill it to acquire some Runes but there isn't anything inside and the door here is locked. Use the bricks and rubble to jump over a low part of the wall and down into the clearing below.

Upon landing, look to your left to find a guardhouse. Go up the stairs and check behind the wooden crates to find x1 Golden Rune [6] that is looted off a corpse. Go back down and head east first towards the entrance of the plaza, there are two Lion Guardian enemies at the north section leading to the main gate that we can ignore for now. Midway up the steps, you'll see a waygate teleporter. Walk past it, continue through the courtyard past the wooden stakes and go inside the room on the right to find the Chamber Outside the Plaza Site of Grace. After discovering the site, go back outside and check the west section. Go up the stairs to another rooftop where you can find a corpse sitting against some wooden crates. Loot it to find x1 Smithing Stone [4].

Go back down towards the west part of the castle where you'll see a hangman's gallows. You'll notice that you are on high ground and you can attack the two Lion Guardian enemies below that are roaming around the castle's main gate. Killing both of the enemies rewards you with Runes along with x2 Somber Smithing Stone [4], x2 Beast Blood, x4 Old Fang. Jump down once the area is clear and loot a corpse that's on a pile of dead bodies and skeletons to find x1 Smithing Stone [4].

Check the tree near the gate to find x1 Arteria Leaf and one Skeletal Slime enemy. Most of the buildings here with the doors are locked, so check the area near the south corner to find a glowing Teardrop Scarab, which will refill your flask if needed. If you haven't discovered the Imapssable Greatbridge site, head back to the waygate teleporter that you passed before, and use it to transport yourself past the heavily-guarded great bridge, near the Impassable Greatbridge site [ Map Coordinates] - after touching the grace, use the waygate to transport back to the castle's plaza.

From the waygate, head north through the doorway, past the site of grace, and enter the plaza where you'll encounter a few NPCs gathered for the Radahn Festival. You can find NPCs such as Blaidd, Alexander, and a maiden who gives you the Polite Bow Gesture if you talk to her. Now, go north, up the stairs, then towards the right where you'll see a large sculpture of a chalice. There's a body on the left side of it - loot it to find x1 Somber Smithing Stone [5]. When you are ready to start the festival, turn back in the direction you just came from and speak to the crier on the right side of the stairs. A cutscene will trigger.

After the cutscene, run up the stairs opposite the crier and enter the chapel where you can loot a body for x1 Smithing Stone [6]. Leave the chapel via the eastern door, and you'll see a lift. Ride it down and at the bottom, you'll find a waygate teleporter and a Stake of Marika next to it. The waygate teleporter will transport you to the boss arena at Wailing Dunes, where you will fight Starscourge Radahn - we highly suggest checking our Starscourge Radahn page to find more guides and strategies on how to defeat this boss.
After defeating Radahn, you will receive Radahn's Great Rune, visit the Divine Tower of Caelid to restore it.

title: Nokron, Eternal City and Ranni's Quest
text: After defeating Rahdahn, you will now have access to Nokron, Eternal City. Follow the walkthrough on that page to procure the Fingerslayer Blade along the way. After finishing with Nokron, give Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade to continue with her quest, refer to Ranni the Witch page for more info. After giving her the blade, Renna's Rise will be opened and you can proceed to the next part of this walkthrough.

title: Elden Ring Walkthrough - Nosktella, Eternal City & Lake of Rot
text: Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Nokstella, Eternal City & Lake of Rot Points of Interest
Explore Ainsel River Main
Acquire Miniature Ranni
Explore Nokstella, Eternal City
Speak to Miniature Ranni
Travel to the Lake of Rot
Defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void
Ringleader's Evergaol

title: Ainsel River Main
text: Elden Ring Map: Nokstella Eternal City Starting Point. Begin from North-West Liurnia of the Lakes. Take the stairs to the very top of Renna's Rise and take the waygate there. It will teleport you to Ainsel River Main, that northern part of Ainsel River that was inaccessible last time you were there. Upon entering through the Waygate, pick up the Miniature Ranni from a coffin, then proceed to the Site of Grace.

Go ahead and hide behind the partial walls to approach the Malformed Star. Take it out for a Somber Smithing Stone (7), then turn around and loot two Glove Gravewort (6), two Ghost Glovewort (6) and one (7), two Golden Rune (7), Human Bone Shard x3, and a Smithing Stone (4). Beware of the Clayman. Behind the Giant Poison Flower (which emits clouds inflicting Madness) near the waterfall are the Clayman Ashes and a Stonesword Key. Make your way back to where the Malformed Star was to pick up another Ghost Glovewort (7).

Head down the tunnel where some Giant Ants are waiting for you, as well as Stimulating Boluses. There are two Ants with wings ahead, as well as an Ant with a reinforced head, reducing the damage you deal with it significantly. Pick up Shield Grease x2 and Golden Rune (10) x8, then head to the left. Go ahead to fight some Scythe-wielding gravity mages, then turn right until see a corpse above you. Drop down and climb onto the ruins to loot the Wing of Astel from a chest. Then go back to get a Somber Smithing Stone (6) from the aforementioned corpse. Go back to where the ants were and take the other way, pick up another Ghost Glovewort (6) in front of the wall, then go up to enter Nokstella, Eternal City.

links.text: Elden Ring Map: Nokstella Eternal City Starting Point

title: Nokstella, Eternal City
text: Continue west and keep following the path up, making sure not to fall back down into the lower floors of Ainsel River, and eventually, you'll reach Nokstella, Eternal City (Elden Ring Map Link). From the Site of Grace, there is Magic Grease x3 in the ruins directly to the left. On the right, you will find a Swordstress riding aGiant Ant, and Ghost Glovewort (7). In the ruin ahead there are two Nox Monk, a Smithing Stone (6), and Drawstring Holy Grease x2. You can go to the right around the larger building ahead to pick up Silver Tear Husk x3. Going straight ahead, there are 3 Poison Snails guarding a Celestial Dew in an alcove to the right. Further down the path, more Snails await you, four of them drop down onto you when you loot the Smithing Stone (6). To your left are many Silver Tears, some of them will explode into lightning upon death, along with another Ant-riding Swordstress.

There are also some tears up on a ledge to the right which have shields and will shoot at you. These ones don't explode. There is a Golden Rune (10) on the right side of the river, a Ghost Glovewort (8) on either side. Consider fighting the remaining tears before picking these up, however. Some of them have shields. Continuing on the right you will find 3 Giant Ants and a Stonesword Key. Take out the remaining Swordstress riders and tears, then pick up another Ghost Glovewort (8). In the far right corner, there are two plated ants that you can simply ignore. The ruin on the left contains a Celestial Dew. Quickly go down the elevator to activate the Nokstella Waterfall Basin Site of Grace, then go back up.

The remainder of this walkthrough is dedicated to picking up items, including a Golden Seed at the end. To start, go to a ruin on your right as you come back up the elevator, on the opposite side of the river from where the tears were shooting you from earlier. It contains a Somber Smithing Stone (7) and many tears. There is a single Golden Centipede in another room. Go further back and up the stairs to fight a Swordstress guarding a chest with Ghost Glovewort (9). Now go back to the Nokstella, Eternal City site of grace.

Next, head up the first stairs on the left where another Swordstress awaits you, along with Fan Daggers on a corpse. Turn left to fight yet another Swordstress who guards a chest containing the Ant's Skull Plate. Note that the chest is not in the center but off to the right. After fighting the tears further up the stairs, head around right hand side of the building on your left to find the Archer Ashes. Inside the building, more tears await you, and a chest containing the Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing (2). Leaving that room, ahead of you is a short set of stairs to a covered balcony which has a window on your left to a room with a chest containing a Somber Smithing Stone (7). Head back out and pick up two Golden Rune (10). Up the stairs at the end of the balcony, go around the building on your left and use a Stonesword Key to find two Nox Monk and a chest with the Nightmaiden & Swordstress Puppets Ashes inside.

Now, upon crossing the bridge, a giant iron ball will roll at you. Try sprinting to the right next to the building ahead, the ball will get stuck. You will see particle effects once it attacks, then you have a short window to attack for yourself. In the building, there is another ball on the ceiling, so try to take it out with ranged attacks from outside. Each ball drops a Larval Tear, the chest inside contains a Great Ghost Glovewort. There is a Golden Rune (10) on the bridge and another one on the stairs. Turn right past the stairs and pick up a Smithing Stone (6).

The building on the left contains another ball along with many tears and a chest with a Somber Smithing Stone (7). On the stairs to the left from here is a Teardrop Scarab carrying a Somber Smithing Stone (6). The building is occupied by two silver tears that transform into humans, and a Swordstress. It also contains a chest with the Moon of Nokstella. Exit to the left, drop down some ledges, and take the elevator down to pick up a Golden Seed. You are done now and can warp to the Nokstella Waterfall Basin Site of Grace. Select the option "Talk to Ranni" until you exhaust the dialogue while resting there, if you want to follow her questline.

There is a Ghost Glovewort (9) to the left of the elevator you came down with, then go through the tunnel. There are three Basilisks here, as well as a Smithing Stone (4) and (5). Fighting the Baleful Shadow here grants you the Discarded Palace Key to be used in the Raya Lucaria Grand Library. Go inside, take the elevator down and touch the Lake of Rot Shoreside Site of Grace, run to the water's edge and find a corpse with the map fragment for the area.

Now that you've got the map and a Site of Grace to teleport to, we're taking a quick detour for Ranni's quest. Feel free to skip this part if you've chosen not to provide your services to her. Teleport back to the Raya Lucaria Grand Library. There is a small chest next to a bookshelf northwest of where Rennala Queen of the Full Moon is sitting that can be unlocked with the Discarded Palace Key that Miniature Ranni handed over to you. Inside you'll find Ranni's ring, the Dark Moon Ring. And with that out of the way, you can teleport back to the Lake of Rot.

links.text: Rennala Queen of the Full Moon

title: Lake of Rot and the Grand Cloister
text: Just a reminder that the waters of Lake of Rot are treacherous and can quickly apply Scarlet Rot each second that you stand in the water. It is recommended to have many Preserving Boluses on hand to remove the status effect immediately and even equip Talismans and Armor that can help alleviate its build-up.

If you look out into the lake, you may be able to see four pillars standing on their own small island in the distance. These small islands have buttons on them that raise landmasses in the lake, giving you safe platforms to stand on while navigating through the Lake of Rot. The nearest pillar to you right now at the starting island should be to your southwest, and after that, the next one should be south of the first pillar. You may notice a familiar-looking boss in the middle of the lake.

Ignore him for now and find the next two pillars to raise all four landmasses in the lake and make item collection and boss fighting easier and much safer. One of the landmasses lifts the button, with you on it, to a raised level. While you're here, you may as well defeat the Alabaster Lord to receive his sword, the Alabaster Lord's Sword, and loot the Somber Smithing Stone (9). There is a slope that leads to a ladder on the east side of the pillar to help you to get down or go back up.

With all the landmasses raised, we can go deal with the boss. In the middle of the lake, next to three raised islands, sits the Dragonkin Soldier once again. Defeat him, being careful not to get knocked down in the water. From here you can choose to loot bodies scattered all around Lake Rot to obtain items, many of which are Somber Smithing Stone (7) & Somber Smithing Stone (8). Several items of note are the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook (22) obtained from a lone chest in a large ruin in the southwestern section of the map, and the Mushroom Crown on a corpse hanging off a pillar in the ruins in the southeast corner.

After you're done with this area, head over to the southern section, where you'll find a waterfall. Climb down the stairs next to it to reach the Grand Cloister and grab the Grand Cloister Site of Grace. The area here is infested with Lesser Kindreds of Rot and there are a few corpses with Golden Runes. If you head north, you'll come across a waterfall with two corpses under it, one with a Smithing Stone (6) and another with a Smithing Stone (7). Be prepared as you approach this waterfall, however, as an Ulcerated Tree Spirit ambushes you from the water. Once you manage to defeat it, you'll be rewarded with a Golden Seed.

Next, head west, where you'll see a bunch of rot prawns dancing in front of a temple. You can kill them one by one since they don't seem to take notice of their surroundings much. When they're all gone, head inside the temple to grab the Scorpion's Stinger. Head back out of the temple and head south, where you'll find an open coffin at the tip of the waterfall. Interact with the coffin to rest in it and a cutscene will play.

If you open your map now, you will find yourself in an isolated area south of the Lake of Rot. Through the mist door, you'll fight Astel, Naturalborn of the Void, defeating this boss, you'll gain the Remembrance of the Naturalborn. You can check our Astel, Naturalborn of the Void page to find various strategies on how to defeat this boss - with all of the underground areas fully explored, head north past his boss room to find a lift that takes you back to the surface at Deep Ainsel Well. Head northeast and you'll come to the Moonlight Altar grace site, located in Western Liurnia, which if you've been following the walkthrough, were inaccessible until now. Here are the few things we can explore here:

Chelona's Rise ( Elden Ring Map Link): A tower found in the very corner of the upper plateau in Liurnia's southwest. This tower is initially sealed, with an imp statue at the entrance holding a glowing book, instructing you to "seek three great wise beasts". See the tower's page for details. You can find the sorcery spell, Ranni's Dark Moon in a chest at the top of this tower. Nearby is the Altar South Site of Grace as well.
Moonfolk Ruins ( Elden Ring Map Link): A ruins section where you can gather some materials and find x1 Somber Smithing Stone [8].

Lunar Estate Ruins ( Elden Ring Map Link): The ruins of a large estate found in the southern plateau of Liurnia, accessible only after making significant progress in Ranni's questline. Once accessible, you can find a Golden Rune [8] in this ruins location.

Cathedral of Manus Celes ( Elden Ring Map Link) Located at Southwest Liurnia of The Lakes. Accessible only after making significant progress in Ranni's questline. However, you can find the Glintstone Dragon Adula roaming around only if you've dealt enough damage to it at its initial location.

Ringleader's Evergaol ( Elden Ring Map Link). Located Northwest from Moonlight Altar site of Grace. This Evergaol does not require a Stonesword Key to unlock as the portal mechanism in the center is active as soon as you enter the area. Within, you can challenge Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader, a remarkably agile and aggressive assassin. Upon defeat, Alecto drops the Black Knife Tiche spirit ashes as well as 80,000 runes.

title: Elden Ring Walkthrough - Altus Plateau
text: Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Altus Plateau Points of Interest
Travel to Altus Plateau
Speak to Millicent
Complete Old Altus Tunnel
Complete The Shaded Castle
Travel to the Golden Lineage Evergaol
Complete the Second Church of Marika and Minor Erdtree
Explore the Eastern Altus Heights
Unlock Mt Gelmir's site of grace

title: Exploring Altus Plateau
text: Elden Ring Map: Altus Plateau Starting Point. The Altus Plateau, northeast of Liurnia, is your next destination. There are two ways to access it: fight your way up through the cliffside dungeon at Ruin-Strewn Precipice (the red-outlined hole on the map, accessed from the northern canyon of Liurnia of the Lakes), or use the left and right halves of the Dectus Medallion at the Grand Lift of Dectus.

Entering from Ruin-Strewn Precipice is better as you can obtain several crafting materials, including a Dragon Heart and Golden Seed within it. You will head up to the plateau from Magma Wyrm Site of grace and can pick up the Ruler's Set shortly after.

You are now at the Abandoned Coffin site of grace ( see it on the map here). Head West from this site of grace and defeat a Teardrop Scarab to loot Ash of War: Sacred Order. Further east, Perfumer's Ruins has the Omenkiller Set, Perfumer's Cookbook (1), and Perfumer's Talisman. Nearby, Unsightly Catacombs has valuable Ghost Glovewort (5) and Grave Glovewort (4) to loot, as well as the Perfumer Tricia spirit ash from the dual boss of the dungeon.

Return to Abandoned Coffin and follow the road north toward Lux Ruins, Ancient Dragon Lansseax will appear and stand in your way but it's an optional fight as you can just run past if you prefer, heading to meet Millicent and collect a Golden Seed before veering slightly south to Erdtree-Gazing Hill and Lux Ruins. Ash of War: Shield Crash can be looted from a teardrop scarab here, and the Greatshield Talisman from a chest further east.

links.text: Elden Ring Map: Altus Plateau Starting Point
right halves of the Dectus Medallion
see it on the map here

title: Elden Ring Walkthrough - The Old Altus Tunnel
text: These tunnels are located southwest of the Bridge of Iniquity in Altus Plateau ( Elden Ring Map Link). The location may be difficult to find due to the large amounts of similarly jagged, rocky hills in the area. The entrance is barred by an Imp Statue which requires 2 Stonesword Key to dispel the fog. The Old Altus Tunnels are a rich source of Cracked Crystals. There are countless amounts of these items found all over the walls and they respawn whenever you rest at a Site of Grace. Be sure to be on the lookout for these if you need them for crafting. Inside, you will predominantly encounter Miners and Zombie Dogs. There are also a couple of Nobles guarding the workers.

From the entrance, check behind the wall on the right for a corpse with 3 Explosive Stone Clumps. Descend the lift to find the Site of Grace. Note that this is the only Site of Grace within these tunnels, but the dungeon isn't particularly long either. When ready, head down the first corridor to find a few barrels and a storage shed on the left. Beware the red barrels marked with a white stripe. These are explosive barrels and can be set off with fire damage. However, you can also use these to your advantage if you have any fire spells. Inside the shed are a Miner and Zombie Dog waiting behind the barrels. Look outside the shed and to the right for a Smithing Stone [5].

Next, you will arrive in a large cave with lots of wooden walkways. Follow the closest one to the right and head up the ladder. This leads to a room with second storage shed on the right and 2 miners chipping away at the crystals while a Noble guards them. Take out the Noble first and two dogs should come rushing out of the shed. After defeating them, check the shed for a Boltdrake Talisman +1, which is an upgrade to the original talisman. Check around the left side of the shed to obtain Somber Smithing Stone [6]. Outside the shed and to its right, you can find Stanching Boluses amongst the crates. In the small alcove right of where the miners were, there is another Smithing Stone [5] behind the barrels. Head back out to where you climbed the ladder and this time, drop down onto the storage shed below to get to the lower level.

Before jumping down, consider taking the enemies below out with ranged attacks from the roof of the storage shed you jumped on. There is a Noble and two enemies here who are quite powerful and tanky but should be rendered helpless with a ranged onslaught from your unreachable location. When you finally drop below, check the shed you were on top of for a Smithing Stone [4]. There is another Smithing Stone [5] in the small space between the shed and the east wall. The shed on the opposite side has a Troll Hammer but watch out for the dogs inside. Check the alcove east of the sheds for yet another Smithing Stone [5]. You can climb up the long ladder here to get to a wooden walkway with two Miners. You will find another Smithing Stone [5] by the walls and a Golden Rune [6] on a corpse in this area. Get back down to the lower level and look for a tunnel on the west side which leads to a small room with a dog and a miner. Defeat them and check the crystals in the room for a Smithing Stone [5] and a Somber Smithing Stone [5].

Finally, go back to the long ladder and head through the tunnel behind it to reach a fog gate that leads to the dungeon's boss: The Stonedigger Troll. This boss is quite simple and is easy to punish at range if you use your Spirit Summons to distract it. Watch out for its roar which can knock you down, allowing the troll to follow up with a devastating smash with its club. Upon defeat, the boss drops the Great Club hammer weapon and 9,600 Runes - exit and continue following the canyon north until you come to a poisonous area, this is the Shaded Castle ( Elden Ring Map Link).

title: Elden Ring Walkthrough - The Shaded Castle
text: The Shaded Castle can be found in the North part of the Altus Plateau between the Mt. Gelmir and the Altus Plateau regions and can be seen while crossing the rope bridge between them near the Bridge of Iniquity Site of Grace. The castle is half-sunken into a poisonous bog with the air tinged yellow by the fumes. The castle can be reached by heading north in between the cliffs between the regions, heading east and north from the Altus Tunnel Site of Grace is a good way to get there. The Second Church of Marika is close to this area through a safe way down to the valley from there may be difficult to find and navigate.

To enter the Castle players can use their steed to jump over low parts of the wall to get on top. One way in can be found is by following the wall to the northwest and climbing the rocks into the wall. Another way in can be found on the northeast side, keep close to the wall when the ground raises to find a low wall that can be jumped into. The northeast entrance is recommended as this entrance is close to the Shaded Castle Ramparts Sites of Grace, follow the wall southwards to find this Site of Grace. Another Site of Grace in this location is the Squire's Residence [ Elden Ring Map Link]

Along the top and within the castle walls players will find Poison Skeletons as well as some humanoid enemies wearing cloaks and a dagger. A variation of the cloaked enemy using a shield and throwing fire can also be found on the walls. Many poison slugs can be found on the ground but also latched on the walls of the castle. 2 Boss enemies from other areas appear in The Shaded Castle as regular enemies, Royal Revenants show up in 2 different places on the castle grounds while Cleanrot Knights can be found in a few different areas atop the walls and within the castle.

From the Shaded Castle Ramparts Site of Grace, there is a ladder that leads into the castle area. A large amount of the castle grounds are covered in poison, walk carefully between safe or raised areas to not accumulate poison status while exploring or fighting in this area of The Shaded Castle. Using ranged attacks and abilities can be very effective in this part of the castle as you stand in safe places or use the height and range advantage of being on the walls to easily deal with the enemies. Within the walls of the castle, there are a few large dead trees that can be seen from far away, powerful enemies can be found under them but also many bodies with treasures found on them. A Royal Revenant can be found under the black tree in the northwest around bodies that hold a Ghost Glovewort (4) and a Somber Smithing Stone (5). You can find a Smithing Stone (5) and Drawstring Fire Grease under the tree in the south of the castle.

There are also rocks that cut out from the ground creating small pockets within the castle grounds where enemies and treasure lie. Within the east side of the outer wall, north from the Shaded Castle Ramparts site of grace, is a small area with the south side walled by rocks. Walking down the stone pillar into the area players will be able to see the "Champion's Song" Painting on the right within a wooden structure, to get to the painting there are a set of stairs at the bottom that players can walk up. Following the outers walls of the castle in the northwest area, there is an area where one can find a large Poisonflower along with many poison skeletons, a Smithing Stone (5) can be found in the corner behind it.

To get further into the castle, there is a ladder leading up to the inner west wall, going over this wall will bring you into the next area of the castle and give you access to the next Site of Grace as well as the ladders up to the main castle areas. Going along the top of this wall, heading to the west, you will find a Cleanrot Knight at the end defending the entrance to a small room there. Defeat them to get to the chest that has the Valkyrie's Prosthesis within, you will need this to advance Millicent's quest. Going east along the wall you will find some poison skeletons and one particularly large one on the wooden bridge.

From the inner west wall, you can climb over the roofs of the broken buildings to get across the gap and reach the Shaded Castle Inner Gate Site of Grace. Alternatively, you can go up the stairs in the middle of this courtyard area then head left to the Site of grace all the same. The inner east wall can be reached by a ladder that leads up from the inner part of the wall on the east side of the courtyard. At the top of this wall are some enemies but also the Perfume Bottle and a Smithing Stone (5) for players to loot. In the middle part of the courtyard up the stairs is a small garden area where a Royal Revenant will spawn and attack the player, also in this garden is a Rot Grease on a body.

The Shaded Castle Inner Gate is the last Site of Grace between the player and the boss, there will be 1 ladder that the player can kick down later to give themselves a shortcut back up. Going further inside the gate, past the many statues, there will be a ladder on the left leading up to the rest of the castle, a spirit NPC can be seen on the right with some clues on what had taken place in this castle.

Heading up into the castle you will start seeing Zombie Dogs and other humanoid enemies within the buildings. Be careful of the small spaces in the buildings and walkways and of being swarmed by multiple enemies. The rooms here have many statues and bookshelves, with enemies hiding behind some of them, the rooms do not have great lighting so a torch is a good idea. Within the first room after going up the ladder there is an Undead Soldier wielding a sword waiting on the side of the entrance ready to jump you. Inside this first room, you'll find a ladder with a ranged enemy next to it and a Page hiding behind the statues. Taking the ladder up will bring you to an open area with no enemies, the Perfumer's Cookbook (2) can be found here on the body sitting on the chair.

Leaving the room leads to an open walkway with a bridge that reaches the other side and the next tower up. On the right is a zombie dog chewing on a body, pillage the body for a Hefty Beast Bone. A Cleanrot Knight can be found on the bridge blocking the way, once across the bridge the next room has many statues but also 2 Page enemies, one behind the statues and one, up the stairs. 2 Gold Fireflies can be found on a body at the back of the room.

Going up the stairs leads to the upper courtyard area of the castle, this is the last area with enemies before the boss and also where a ladder can be found that when kicked down will help create a shortcut from the Inner Gate Sites of Grace. Another Cleanrot Knight can be found defending the central tower, there are also many zombie dogs in this area, be careful with being surrounded by them. Once this area is clear head to the opposite side of the courtyard from the entrance to find a lit brazier near the edge with a ladder to kick down. The central tower holds an elevator for players to go up, across the bridge at the top is the boss fight for this area.

Elemer of the Briar is a humanoid boss that primarily uses one large sword to fight the player that deals a large amount of damage with their attacks. The large greatsword they use and the shield on their back are both dropped when the boss is defeated. While this boss is a melee fighter, the sword that the boss uses can be thrown and used at a range, the boss can even continue attacking at range before retrieving their sword. Watch out for when their arm or weapon glows red to dodge out of the way of their attacks. After beating the boss, in the hall where they are defeated the Castellan's Hall Site of Grace appears and becomes available to use and he drops the Marais Executioner's Sword along with the Briar Greatshield, you can visit our Elemer of the Briar page to find more guides and strategies on how to defeat this boss.

title: Other Points of Interest in Altus Plateau
text: Once you've completed this location, there are a few things you may want to check before proceeding to the next area:

Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan ( Elden Ring Map Link): Located on the west side, outside of The Shaded Castle, is a hostile NPC who will chase and attack you when you are seen. Defeating this hostile NPC will drop the House Marais Set and Antspur Rapier.
Golden Lineage Evergaol ( Elden Ring Map Link): Evergaol is located in the south-western Altus Plateau. Godefroy the Grafted is imprisoned within. Defeating the boss drops the Godfrey Icon talisman.

You can follow now follow the main road north and activate the Altus Highway Junction site of grace, nearby you can meet Boc the Seamster and advance his quest. North from here, the road takes you to a Golden Seed and Map (Altus Plateau) to reveal the region.

Slightly north, talk to Brother Corhyn who is looking for the Goldmask. Directly east from the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace, follow the road until it breaks off north into an open cave, in the cave the Amber Starlight will be sitting below a statue surrounded by octopus ball creatures. Map Link - you need this item for Seluvis's quest if you are doing it, but in this playthrough, we have already bypassed his side-quest.

Keep following the road north then go West to visit the Second Church of Marika and loot the Crystal Tear there. Bloody Finger Hunter Yura will be here, and if you talk to him you will trigger an invasion from Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger, who allows for the acquisition of Purifying Crystal Tear alongside Eleonora's Poleblade. This is a VERY useful item for an upcoming Boss fight, and doing Yura's quest is not necessarily required for her to spawn, but the triggers are unclear at this time.

Return to the road and follow it to the valley with the Minor Erdtree. The tree is protected by Wormface, a boss that drops Speckled Hardtear and Crimsonspill Crystal Tear. There's also a Golden Seed slightly north and west of the tree. Within this valley, you will find Mirage Rise to the west, which asks that you find symbols in the valley to unlock the tower and gain the Unseen Form and Unseen Blade spells. To the East, Altus Tunnel has Smithing Stone (5) upgrades and the Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing (2). Woodfolk Ruins has an underground cellar with Wrath of Gold in a chest, another one with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook (19), and a teardrop scarab with Ash of War: Golden Slam in the northern area of the ruins.

Go north of the minor erdtree through a small village area. Take a right on the cobblestone path at the intersection. Continue through the small wooded area, be careful of a ballista/catapult that will be shooting at you. On your left there is a lookout tower. Near it you can find a Golden Seed. From this point East, enemies will shoot at you with deadly ballistae and catapults. Instead of going East toward the capital, go north into Dominula, Windmill Village. Here you can defeat the Godskin Apostle boss that drops the Scouring Black Flame incantation, after which you can talk to Millicent again. The area also has the Goskin Peeler twinblade and Celebrant's Skull warhammer.

If you return to the road, there's the option to head East into Lyndell, Capital City outskirts. We will leave this for later and instead take the lower road southeast. This will bring you to an unnamed ruins where a noble will transform into a Lion Guardian. Defeat it to get a Larval Tear, then continue following the road until you come to an elevation with lightning and Ancient Dragon Lansseax. This is an optional fight, and west from here there's another boss encounter with a Black Knife Assassin just outside the Sainted Hero's Grave. The grave has the Crimson Seed Talisman and Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +1. South from here, Stormcaller Church has a Sacred Tear, as well as the Dragonbolt Blessing incantation.

You have now successfully looted the eastern part of Altus Plains, so backtrack to Dominula, Windmill Village, and head west instead. Following the main road without going up you will arrive to meet Goldmask near the collapsed bridge. The lower area has Radiant Gold Mask helm. After interacting with Goldmask, go back to Brother Corhyn near the Altus Highway Junction site of grace and tell him of your finding. He will move to Goldmask's location.

Travel back to Goldmask and Corhyn will have more incantations to sell, and dialogue that you should exhaust to progress his quest. To the north from here, in the higher areas, the Windmill Pastures (East and West) hold the Noble's Set, Battlemage Set, and Giant Rat Ashes. You can do a quick sweep of this before dropping back to the road and taking the Great Stars Warhammer from the enemy Hearse traveling here. Following this road West leads you directly to Mt. Gelmir, but it's a good idea to follow it until the Bridge of Iniquity site of grace to activate it for teleporting. The road ahead from here is a dead end with difficult enemies leading to an invasion by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater, and the Golden Vow (Spell).

title: Elden Ring Walkthrough - Mt. Gelmir
text: Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Mt. Gelmir Points of Interest
Complete Wyndham Ruins
Complete Wyndham Catacombs
Travel to Fort Laeidd
Defeat the Magma Wyrm
Explore Gelmir Hero's Grave
Travel to the Volcano Manor

title: The Wyndham Ruins & Catacombs
text: Elden Ring Map: Mt. Gelmir Starting Point. We'll complete a couple of locations that are technically Altus Plains to make it easier to understand progress. From the Erdtree-Gazing Hill site of grace, go straight north and up to arrive at Wyndham Ruins and Wyndham Catacombs. There's a Tibia Mariner at the Wyndham Ruins to defeat and earn a Deathroot as well as Tibia's Summons spell.

Wyndham Catacombs is just near the ruins on the northwest side of the map from the ruins. Leaving the Wyndham Catacombs Site of Grace the only room at the top of the catacombs is the locked door with the 2 statues, locked by some contraption. Moving past this door is a room with an elevator, beware of the trap button between the rooms as this will fire a row of 3 lightning shots 3 times. The elevator is a simple platform with a button that players can step on to get the elevator to move. At the top and bottom of the elevator shaft are levers that will call the elevator to the player when needed.

Once at the bottom of the elevator shaft hit the button once more to have it rise then roll off onto the ledge above to collect the Grave Glovewort on the ledge above. The first room outside the elevator shaft has 2 imps throwing lightning bombs as well as a large guillotine trap cutting the room in half that raises and drops repeatedly. Past this room around the corner is a room with 2 imps, one on the far wall from where you enter as well as one directly on the right of the entrance.

Following the path down the narrow stairs brings you into the large underground sewer area with watery ground and many slimes and skeletons. There is a lightning trap hidden in the water in the middle of the room, stepping on the trap will cause lightning to strike down around the trap, enemies do not trigger the trap but the trap rearms quickly so watch out and avoid the damage. Moving forward and around the bend, players will find a Leyndell Knight defending the way forward.

At the top of the ladder watch out for the trap on the ground close to the ladder that will fire lightning bolts from behind. There is an imp statue sealing the room ahead and a path leading left, on the crossroad an Imp will attack you so be ready. The sealed room requires a Stonesword Key to open and holds the Lightning Scorpion Charm but otherwise has no enemies or other loot.

The next room in the Catacombs is the room with the spike ceiling and a raising floor platform.
