title: Elden Ring Walkthrough - Leyndell, Ashen Capital
text: Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Leyndell, Ashen Capital Points of Interest
Explore the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds
Grab the Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
Complete Brother Corhyn/Goldmask's quest
Defeat an old ally, now boss
Defeat Godfrey, First Elden Lord/Hoarah Loux, Warrior
Defeat Radagon of the Golden Order/Elden Beast

Leyndell, Ashen Capital is an instance of Leyndell, Royal Capital after it falls into ruin. This version of the capital is accessible only after making significant story progress and is geared towards high-leveled players. The Capital of Ash features the same structures and landmarks as its intact counterpart, albeit altered in slight or significant ways. Previously open paths may not be accessible and vice versa. The Capital of Ash also features its own set of enemies, bosses, and collectibles with varied placement distinct from the regular version of the city.

To get to the Capital of Ash, defeat Maliketh, the Black Blade at Crumbling Farum Azula after the events at the Forge of the Giants, and after a cutscene plays, you'll get teleported right to the Leyndell, Ashen Capital Site of Grace. Most of the progression in the Capital of Ash involves beating various bosses and after defeating the final boss of this area, you can reach the ending of the game.

From the Site of Grace, if you haven't explored the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds in Leyndell, Royal Capital yet, you can find a sewer hole in the ruined road southwest to access it. If you jump down from here, you can access a wooden beam with a corpse holding the Crimson Amber Medallion +2 hanging off of it. Teleport back to the Site of Grace and head south to find a corpse with a Rune Arc on it. In the area, you may also find corpses with a Tarnished Golden Sunflower and a Golden Sunflower within some of the ruins. Make your way southwest from the Rune Arc to find a set of stairs.

title: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds Walkthrough
text: After completing the Crumbling Farum Azula (defeating the main boss there) Leyndell... will have changed. You'll want to return there, Leyndell, to gain access to areas that you couldn't access before. One location is found at the center of Leyndell; a hole where you can fall into. Make sure you ease your fall by aiming at the wooden platform, then outside the small hole, then the wooden beam, and then the platform next to it.

Alternatively, you can reach this area earlier in the game. From the Avenue Balcony site of grace, head down the stairs and through the door. Take a left immediately outside the door to avoid the archer and hop over onto the roof below. Drop down into the courtyard to your right, where you will be ambushed by a few crawling enemies. In the dark corner of this courtyard is a well with a ladder that leads down to the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.

If you have a ranged build, you may kill the hostiles below before you go all the way down. Go down the ladder, walk the hallway, there's a door that can't be opened from your side to the right, and a Site of Grace to the left called Underground Roadside.

Go to the room, with the big pipes, expect Fanged Imps. Walk over the pipes to the end of the way. There's a room with a dead body sitting with an item guarded by an Ogre ready to surprise you, and to the right, there's a lever that will open the gate that leads to the previous area before you enter the pipe room. The dead body item is a Shadow Bait.

Go back to the Pipe Room, there's a big pipe lower than the pipes you are standing on, and you can jump on it safely to then jump below. Use the pipe sections to find safety when the Giant Lobster attacks you. You can skip the lobsters by running into these pipe parts. Head to the southeast, there's a hole in the wall where you can enter a dungeon area.
Go forward to head into an elevator, follow the linear path to go back to the first main area of the Underground.
If you head to the opposite way of the main hall at the beginning of this location, you will see a piece of grid missing on the ground, go down into the sewers.

The Sewers are a labyrinthine series of interconnected pipes. These are filled with easy hostiles (rats, slugs) until you reach the Omens near the end. After dropping into the missing grate hole, you can either follow the tunnel as it turns to the left or turn right into an adjacent pipe. To reach theDung Eater's corporeal form, follow the tunnel—you will need to run past three Giant Poison Flowers to reach a ladder at the end (the last of these flowers will use a magic attack, but it will not strike you while climbing.) In the room at the top of the ladder, be wary of enemies—there are several small Fingercreepers as well as a large one hiding near the center of the room (strike the visible nails to thwart its ambush.) If you have the Sewer-Gaol Key, you can open the cell at the other end of the room to speak to the Dung Eater and advance his quest.

Returning to the original tunnel, enter the pipe that is now on our left—this leads into a maze of pipes. Be wary of holes—the first hole you encounter will drop into a lower pipe, while the second will deposit you in a mucky room full of corpses, with a surprise appearance by a Royal Revenant at one end of the chamber. If you fall in, make a mad dash for the exit pipe in the corner. If you successfully avoid the holes, the pipes will eventually lead to a room with an item on a corpse and a ladder at the far end. There is an Omen waiting at the top that will jump down to engage as you approach, so be prepared for melee combat or use ranged attacks as you back up into the pipe. You can run past the Omen rather than fighting, but it can (and will) climb ladders to pursue you. Next, move up the ladder and go forward, opening the large doors ahead into a room with a great precipice and stairs leading down to the right. Collect the items down the stairs, but note that these stairs are broken—return to the top of the stair and look down to the left, and you will see a safe location to drop onto the next level of stairs.

You will find a tall ladder that leads to the door that you were not able to open before right in front of the Site of Grace. Open it so you can use this path as a shortcut in case you are defeated or if you want to refill your stats and flasks.with that door now open, start at the Underground Roadside Grace and proceed straight through the door you just opened, follow the pipe to the right of the opposite doorway to the end, and proceed to jump off to the left of the wooden platform(beware the imp directly below you). proceed to go to the nearby doorway, beware of the imp that will jump out swinging from the said doorway, go through the doorway, but DO NOT TAKE THE LADDER, it is a trap, jump down into the mouth of the open sewer pipe, and follow it the direction of the bend, until you hit a fork in the pipes, it is a loop. taking the left will have a hole in it, drop down and kill the commoner, you can open the nearby gate to open a shortcut back here from the much earlier pipe maze. proceed down the slope and climb down the ladder to find a room full of living jars, one of them is a large jar, so be careful. proceed down the elevator to the right of this room to find the Forsaken Depths Grace, and directly ahead is the room you fight Mohg, the Omen.

title: The Remains of the Royal City
text: To the west, you'll find a ruined part of Leyndell's walls with an illusory tree marking a Golden Seed (you've probably already grabbed this if you've fully explored Leyndell, Royal Capital). From this illusory tree, head down the stairs directly north, and when you emerge back outside, head northwest to find a Valiant Gargoyle. You'll find a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone tucked in a corner if you check behind the wall it's standing in front of.

If you're doing the Brother Corhyn questline, head back to the curved staircase, and to the right of it, between the stairs and the ruined wall is an ash-covered slope going down. Run across the large tree branch to find a Smithing Stone (6) and follow the cliff face east. You'll find Goldmask sitting right up against it not too far ahead, and can receive the Mending Rune of Perfect Order from him. If you reload the area, you'll be able to get his armor set, Goldmask's Set, minus the mask.

Backtrack to the staircase and at the top, take the lift to go up onto a higher level. Here, you'll find Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing who is adamant about stopping you from becoming Elden Lord. Defeat him and you'll be rewarded with the All-Knowing Set and the Scepter of All-Knowing.

Interact with the Erdtree Sanctuary Site of Grace that spawns after Gideon's defeat, and head east out to the main balcony. Turn left and scale the tree root here up and to the west. When you get up onto the balcony, you'll see an item on a hanging chair to your south. Head outside and instead of following the path, immediately turn left. Jump down onto the roof around the corner and head into the one open window. Run across the large tree root here to be able to grab the Golden Order Principia, then head back down to that balcony where you first saw the item. This time, follow the path north and you'll get to the Queen's Bedchambers. Here, you'll find the Erdtree Heal incantation in the middle of the 'bed'.

Continue out the door east and up the stairs, you'll encounter a fog door. Beyond this door is Godfrey, First Elden Lord in his physical form rather than the golden spectral form you encountered earlier in the game. After taking him down to about 33% health, he turns into Hoarah Loux, Warrior, and defeating him nets you the Remembrance of Hoarah Loux.

Interact with the Elden Throne Site of Grace that spawned and head up the stairs to the southeast. Touching the golden light at the top teleports you to the final two bosses of the game, the first of which is Radagon of the Golden Order. Defeat him and the next phase against the Elden Beast starts immediately after the transitional cutscene. Defeat them both to be rewarded the Elden Remembrance and to be able to interact with Fractured Marika, ending this playthrough of the game. For a list of the other endings, you can visit the Endings page, be warned for spoilers. Congratulations on completing your first playthrough of Elden Ring. You can also visit the New Game Plus to learn more about the different features and changes that carry over upon starting NG+.
